pokedexEntries.Yellow: It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.
pokedexEntries.Gold: This intelligent Pokemon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It raises its tail to check its sur roundings. The tail is sometimes struck by light ning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: When it is anger ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

pokedexEntries.Emerald: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.

pokedexEntries.Pearl: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Jigglypuff has top-notch lung capacity, even by comparison to other Pokemon. It won't stop singing its lullabies until its foes fall asleep.

pokedexEntries.Scarlet: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

name: wigglytuff
flavorText: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.

pokedexEntries.Blue: The body is soft and rubbery. When angered, it will suck in air and inflate itself to an enormous size.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Its body is full of elasticity. By inhaling deeply, it can continue to inflate itself without limit.
pokedexEntries.Gold: Their fur feels so good that if two of them snuggle together, they won't want to be separated.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It has a very fine fur. Take care not to make it angry, or it may inflate steadily and hit with a body slam.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: The rich, fluffy fur that covers its body feels so good that anyone who feels it can't stop touching it.

pokedexEntries.Sapphire: WIGGLYTUFF's body is very flexible. By inhaling deeply, this Pokemon can inflate itself seemingly without end. Once inflated, Wigglytuff bounces along lightly like a balloon.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: Its fur is the ultimate in luxuriousness. Sleeping alongside a Wigglytuff is simply divine. Its body expands seemingly without end when it inhales.
pokedexEntries.Firered: Its fur is extremely fine, dense, and supple. The exquisitely pleasant fur conveys an image of luxury.

name: zubat
flavorText: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.

pokedexEntries.Red: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
pokedexEntries.Blue: Forms colonies in perpetually dark places. Uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for ob jects in its way.
pokedexEntries.Gold: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its sur roundings.
pokedexEntries.Silver: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: During the day, it gathers with others and hangs from the ceilings of old buildings and caves.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Zubat remains quietly unmoving in a dark spot during the bright daylight hours. It does so because prolonged exposure to the sun causes its body to become slightly burned.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Zubat avoids sunlight because exposure causes it to become unhealthy. During the daytime, it stays in caves or under the eaves of old houses, sleeping while hanging upside down.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: While living in pitch-black caverns, their eyes gradually grew shut and deprived them of vision. They use ultrasonic waves to detect obstacles.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It has no eyes. Instead, it relies on its ultrasonic cries for echo location to flit about in darkness.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: It forms colonies in perpetually dark places and uses ultrasonic waves to identify and approach targets.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: Disliking sunlight, it sleeps deep in forests and caves until sundown.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: While flying, it constantly emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings.
pokedexEntries.Soulsilver: Capable of flying safely in dark places, it emits ultrasonic cries to check for any obstacles.
pokedexEntries.Black: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
pokedexEntries.White: It checks its surroundings and location using reflections of the ultrasonic waves from its mouth.

pokedexEntries.White 2: It does not need eyes, because it emits ultrasonic waves to check its surroundings while it flies.
pokedexEntries.X: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Emits ultrasonic cries while it flies. They act as a sonar used to check for objects in its way.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokemon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.

name: golbat

pokedexEntries.Blue: Once it strikes, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

pokedexEntries.Gold: However hard its victim's hide may be, it punctures with sharp fangs and gorges itself with blood.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It can drink more than 10 ounces of blood at once. If it has too much, it gets heavy and flies clumsily.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: When it plunges its fangs into its prey, it instantly draws and gulps down more than ten ounces of blood.

pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Golbat bites down on prey with its four fangs and drinks the victim's blood. It becomes active on inky dark moonless nights, flying around to attack people and Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: Its fangs easily puncture even thick animal hide. It loves to feast on the blood of people and Pokemon. It flits about in darkness and strikes from behind.

pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Once it bites, it will not stop draining energy from the victim even if it gets too heavy to fly.

pokedexEntries.Platinum: Its sharp fangs puncture the toughest of hides and have small holes for greedily sucking blood.

pokedexEntries.Blue: While lulling its enemies with its vacant look, this wily Pokemon will use psychokinetic powers.

pokedexEntries.White: A Pokemon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.
pokedexEntries.White 2: Extremely loyal to its Trainer, it will bark at those who approach the Trainer unexpectedly and run them out of town.
pokedexEntries.X: Very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.
pokedexEntries.Y: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Growlithe has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this Pokemon won't forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Growlithe has a superb sense of smell. Once it smells anything, this Pokemon won't forget the scent, no matter what. It uses its advanced olfactory sense to determine the emotions of other living things.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It looks cute, but when you approach another Trainer's Growlithe, it will bark at you and bite.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It has lived alongside humans since ages ago. Its bones have been found in excavations of ruins from the Stone Age.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: A Pokemon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: A Pokemon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.

pokedexEntries.Violet: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

name: poliwag

pokedexEntries.Blue: Its newly grown legs prevent it from running. It appears to prefer swimming than trying to stand.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
pokedexEntries.Gold: Because it is in ept at walking on its newly grown legs, it always swims around in water.
pokedexEntries.Silver: The direction of its belly spiral differs by area. The equator is thought to have an effect on this.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It looks clearer after it eats.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Poliwag has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the Pokemon's spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Poliwag has a very thin skin. It is possible to see the Pokemon's spiral innards right through the skin. Despite its thinness, however, the skin is also very flexible. Even sharp fangs bounce right off it.

pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Its newly grown legs prevent it from walking well. It appears to prefer swimming over walking.

pokedexEntries.Sun: The swirl on its belly is its internal organs showing through. If the swirl is tinged white, that means it's affected by some disease.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's still not very good at walking. Its Trainers should train this Pokemon to walk every day.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The direction of the swirl on their stomachs differs depending on where they live. Poliwag aficionados can tell them apart at a glance.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: The direction of the spiral on the belly differs by area. It is more adept at swimming than walking.
pokedexEntries.Sword: For Poliwag, swimming is easier than walking. The swirl pattern on its belly is actually part of the Pokemon's innards showing through the skin.
pokedexEntries.Shield: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokemon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The swirl on its belly is its insides showing through the skin. It appears more clearly after Poliwag eats.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Its legs are newly grown, and it can't walk very well. It seems to prefer swimming through the water instead.

pokedexEntries.Blue: Capable of living in or out of water. When out of water, it sweats to keep its body slimy.

pokedexEntries.Shield: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Although it's skilled in a style of dynamic swimming that uses all its muscles, for some reason it lives on dry land.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.

name: abra
flavorText: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

pokedexEntries.Red: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.
pokedexEntries.Blue: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
pokedexEntries.Gold: It senses impend ing attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
pokedexEntries.Silver: If it decides to teleport randomly, it creates the illusion that it has created copies of itself.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: It hypnotizes itself so that it can teleport away when it senses danger, even if it is asleep.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Abra sleeps for eighteen hours a day. However, it can sense the presence of foes even while it is sleeping. In such a situation, this Pokemon immediately teleports to safety.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Abra needs to sleep for eighteen hours a day. If it doesn't, this Pokemon loses its ability to use telekinetic powers. If it is attacked, Abra escapes using teleport while it is still sleeping.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: A Pokemon that sleeps 18 hours a day. Observation revealed that it uses teleport to change its location once every hour.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. It uses a variety of extrasensory powers even while asleep.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Using its ability to read minds, it will sense impending danger and teleport to safety.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: Even while asleep, it maintains a telepathic radar. It teleports when it is threatened.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: It senses impending attacks and teleports away to safety before the actual attacks can strike.
pokedexEntries.Soulsilver: If it decides to teleport randomly, it evokes the illusion that it has created copies of itself.
pokedexEntries.Black: Using its psychic power is such a strain on its brain that it needs to sleep for 18 hours a day.

pokedexEntries.Moon: It can teleport itself to safety while it's asleep, but when it wakes, it doesn't know where it is, so it panics.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It uses various psychic powers even while it's sleeping, so you can't tell whether or not it's awake.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It can read others' minds and will teleport away when danger approaches. You must clear your mind if you want to catch it.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Sleeps 18 hours a day. If it senses danger, it will teleport itself to safety even as it sleeps.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokemon wields.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokemon will simply teleport away.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Using its ability to read minds, it will identify impending danger and teleport to safety.

name: kadabra
flavorText: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.

pokedexEntries.Red: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
pokedexEntries.Blue: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close by.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Many odd things happen if this Pokemon is close by. For example, it makes clocks run backwards.
pokedexEntries.Gold: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.
pokedexEntries.Silver: If it uses its abilities, it emits special alpha waves that cause machines to malfunction.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: When it closes its eyes, twice as many alpha parti cles come out of the surface of its body.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Kadabra emits a peculiar alpha wave if it develops a headache. Only those people with a particularly strong psyche can hope to become a trainer of this Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Kadabra holds a silver spoon in its hand. The spoon is used to amplify the alpha waves in its brain. Without the spoon, the Pokemon is said to be limited to half the usual amount of its telekinetic powers.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: It is rumored that a boy with psychic abilities suddenly transformed into Kadabra while he was assisting research into extrasensory powers.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It happened one morning - a boy with extrasensory powers awoke in bed transformed into Kadabra.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: It emits special alpha waves from its body that induce headaches just by being close.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: When it uses its psychic power, it emits strong ha waves that can ruin precision devices.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: It stares at its silver spoon to focus its mind. It emits more alpha waves while doing so.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: It possesses strong spiritual power. The more danger it faces, the stronger its psychic power.

pokedexEntries.Moon: Kadabra's presence infests televisions and monitors with creepy shadows that bring bad luck.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It stares at a silver spoon to amplify its psychic powers before it lets loose. Apparently, gold spoons are no good.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It possesses strong mental capabilities, but its psychic powers are halved when it's not holding a silver spoon.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.

name: tentacool
flavorText: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.

pokedexEntries.Red: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
pokedexEntries.Blue: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by its stinging acid.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
pokedexEntries.Gold: When the tide goes out, dehydrated Tentacool remains can be found washed up on the shore.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It drifts aimless ly in waves. Very difficult to see in water, it may not be noticed until it stings.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: As it floats along on the waves, it uses its toxic feelers to stab anything it touches.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: TENTACOOL's body is largely composed of water. If it is removed from the sea, it dries up like parchment. If this Pokemon happens to become dehydrated, put it back into the sea.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Tentacool absorbs sunlight and refracts it using water inside its body to convert it into beam energy. This Pokemon shoots beams from its crystal-like eyes.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: Its body is almost entirely composed of water. It ensnares its foe with its two long tentacles, then stabs with the poison stingers at their tips.
pokedexEntries.Firered: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Drifts in shallow seas. Anglers who hook them by accident are often punished by their stingers.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: Its body is virtually composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: It drifts in sea currents. Countless fishermen are hurt by its poison stingers.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: Because its body is almost entirely composed of water, it shrivels up if it is washed ashore.

pokedexEntries.Moon: It drifts in shallow seas, such as the areas near beaches. If you get bitten or stabbed by its toxic tentacles, rush to the hospital.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: It can sometimes be found all dry and shriveled up on a beach. Toss it back into the sea to revive it.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Tentacool is not a particularly strong swimmer. It drifts across the surface of shallow seas as it searches for prey.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: When the tide goes out, dehydrated Tentacool can be found left behind on the shore.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Its eyes are as transparent as crystals. From them, it shoots mysterious beams of light.

name: tentacruel

pokedexEntries.Blue: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and contract freely. They wrap around prey and weaken it with poison.
pokedexEntries.Gold: Its 80 tentacles absorb water and stretch almost endlessly to con strict its prey and enemies.
pokedexEntries.Silver: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its oppo nent inside a poisonous net.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: When its 80 feel ers absorb water, it stretches to become like a net to entangle its prey.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Tentacruel has large red orbs on its head. The orbs glow before lashing the vicinity with a harsh ultrasonic blast. This Pokemon's outburst creates rough waves around it.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Tentacruel has tentacles that can be freely elongated and shortened at will. It ensnares prey with its tentacles and weakens the prey by dosing it with a harsh toxin. It can catch up to 80 prey at the same time.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: It lives in complex rock formations on the ocean floor and traps prey using its 80 tentacles. Its red orbs glow when it grows excited or agitated.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It has 80 tentacles that move about freely. They can sting, causing poisoning and sharp, stabbing pain.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: The tentacles are normally kept short. On hunts, they are extended to ensnare and immobilize prey.

pokedexEntries.Pearl: It alerts others to danger by stridently flashing the red orbs on its head.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: It extends its 80 tentacles to form an encircling poisonous net that is difficult to escape.

pokedexEntries.Violet: In battle, it extends all 80 of its tentacles to entrap its opponent inside a poisonous net.

name: geodude
flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

pokedexEntries.Red: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
pokedexEntries.Blue: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Commonly found near mountain trails, etc. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
pokedexEntries.Gold: Most people may not notice, but a closer look should reveal that there are many Geodude around.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It uses its arms to steadily climb steep mountain paths. It swings its fists around if angered.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: Proud of their sturdy bodies, they bash against each other in a contest to prove whose is harder.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: The longer a Geodude lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this Pokemon's heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: When Geodude sleeps deeply, it buries itself halfway into the ground. It will not awaken even if hikers step on it unwittingly. In the morning, this Pokemon rolls downhill in search of food.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: It climbs mountain paths using only the power of its arms. Because they look just like boulders lining paths, hikers may step on them without noticing.
pokedexEntries.Firered: Its round form makes it easy to pick up. Some people have used them to hurl at each other in a snowball fight.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: Many live on mountain trails and remain half buried while keeping an eye on climbers.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: It is impossible to distinguish from rocks. It slams against others in contests of hardness.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: At rest, it looks just like a rock. Carelessly stepping on it will make it swing its fists angrily.

name: graveler
flavorText: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

pokedexEntries.Red: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
pokedexEntries.Blue: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
pokedexEntries.Gold: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
pokedexEntries.Silver: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: It travels by rol ling on mountain paths. If it gains too much speed, it stops by running into huge rocks.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Graveler grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This Pokemon eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Rocks are GRAVELER's favorite food. This Pokemon will climb a mountain from the base to the summit, crunchingly feasting on rocks all the while. Upon reaching the peak, it rolls back down to the bottom.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: They descend from mountains by tumbling down steep slopes. They are so brutal, they smash aside obstructing trees and massive boulders with thunderous tackles.
pokedexEntries.Firered: Be careful while hiking on mountain trails. Graveler may come rolling down the path without slowing.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: Graveler make their homes on sheer cliff faces by gouging out numerous horizontal holes.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: It tumbles down slopes, heedless of any body parts chipping off. It eats a ton of rocks daily.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: It rolls on mountain paths to move. Once it builds momentum, no Pokemon can stop it without difficulty.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.

pokedexEntries.Scarlet: A slow walker, it rolls to move. It pays no attention to any object that happens to be in its path.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Moss-covered rocks are Graveler's favorite food. It consumes over a ton of them a day, crunching loudly while it eats.

name: golem

pokedexEntries.Red: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
pokedexEntries.Blue: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.
pokedexEntries.Gold: It sheds its skin once a year. The discarded shell immediately hard ens and crumbles away.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It is capable of blowing itself up. It uses this explosive force to jump from mountain to mountain.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: Its rock-like body is so durable, even high-powered dynamite blasts fail to scratch its rugged hide.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Golem live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these Pokemon will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Golem is known for rolling down from mountains. To prevent them from rolling into the homes of people downhill, grooves have been dug into the sides of mountains to serve as guideways for diverting this Pokemon's course.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: It is said to live in volcanic craters on mountain peaks. Once a year, it sheds its hide and grows larger. The shed hide crumbles and returns to the soil.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without taking damage.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulderlike body is so tough, even dynamite can't harm it.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: Even dynamite can't harm its hard, boulderlike body. It sheds its hide just once a year.

pokedexEntries.Moon: Once a year, this Pokemon molts, and its shed shell returns to the soil. This process creates enriched soil, so farmers collect the shells.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It is enclosed in a hard shell that is as rugged as slabs of rock. It sheds skin once a year to grow larger.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It deliberately blows itself up, then uses this explosive force to jump from mountain to mountain.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

pokedexEntries.Blue: Uses anti-gravity to stay suspended. Appears without warning and uses thunder wave and similar moves.

pokedexEntries.Gold: It is attracted by electromagnetic waves. It may approach trainers if they are using their POKéGEAR.

pokedexEntries.Emerald: The units at its sides are extremely powerful magnets. They generate enough magnetism to draw in iron objects from over 300 feet away.

name: koffing

pokedexEntries.Blue: Because it stores several kinds of toxic gases in its body, it is prone to exploding without warning.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: In hot places, its internal gases could expand and explode without any warning. Be very careful!
pokedexEntries.Gold: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
pokedexEntries.Silver: The poisonous gases it contains are a little bit lighter than air, keeping it slight ly airborne.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: If one gets close enough to it when it expels poison ous gas, the gas swirling inside it can be seen.

pokedexEntries.Blue: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

pokedexEntries.Emerald: By diluting its toxic gases with a special process, the highest grade of perfume can be extracted. To Weezing, gases emanating from garbage are the ultimate feast.
pokedexEntries.Firered: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, two Koffing can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

pokedexEntries.Blue: A rare and elusive Pokemon that is said to bring happiness to those who manage to get it.

pokedexEntries.Gold: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.

pokedexEntries.Crystal: People try to catch it for its extremely nutritious eggs, but it rarely can be found.

pokedexEntries.Pearl: It lays several eggs a day and won't share them with those who have evil in their hearts.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: A kindly Pokemon that lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokemon or people.

flavorText: At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokemon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

flavorText: CARVANHA's strongly developed jaws and its sharply pointed fangs pack the destructive power to rip out boat hulls. Many boats have been attacked and sunk by this Pokemon.

name: cranidos
flavorText: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

name: rampardos

name: shieldon
flavorText: A Pokemon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

pokedexEntries.Platinum: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it can eat grass and berries without having to fight.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: It was generated from a fossil dug out of a layer of clay that was older than anyone knows. It has a sturdy face.

pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Much remains unknown about this Pokemon, as few have ever seen it. However, we know that it is calm and dislikes conflict, and it enjoys polishing its face against trees and rocks.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It is outstandingly armored. As a result, it has no particular need to battle with others and can spend its time feeding on grass and berries.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon lived in primeval jungles. It's thought that Shieldon had few enemies thanks to its sturdy face.

pokedexEntries.White: With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.
pokedexEntries.White 2: The dream mist coming from its forehead changes into many different colors depending on the dream that was eaten.

name: pidove
flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

pokedexEntries.White: These Pokemon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

name: tranquill
flavorText: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

pokedexEntries.Black: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.
pokedexEntries.White: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.
pokedexEntries.White 2: No matter where in the world it goes, it knows where its nest is, so it never gets separated from its Trainer.

name: roggenrola
flavorText: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.

pokedexEntries.Black: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
pokedexEntries.White: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: The hexagonal-shaped hole is its ear. It has a tendency to walk in the direction the sound is coming from.
pokedexEntries.White 2: The hexagonal-shaped hole is its ear. It has a tendency to walk in the direction the sound is coming from.
pokedexEntries.X: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
pokedexEntries.Y: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Its ear is hexagonal in shape. Compressed underground, its body is as hard as steel.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Born deep within the ground, it compares itself with similar species, such as Geodude and Carbink, to settle which has the hardest body.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The hexagonal cavity is its ear. It walks in the direction of sounds it hears, but if the sounds cease, it panics and topples over.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The hexagonal hole is its ear. Deep in that ear is an energy core, so if you stick your hand in there, Roggenrola will be very angry!
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It was found in a fissure in a layer of exposed rock. The material that makes up its body is dirt from several hundred years ago.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It's as hard as steel, but apparently a long soak in water will cause it to soften a bit.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokemon slightly warm to the touch.

name: boldore
flavorText: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.

pokedexEntries.Black: When it overflows with power, the orange crystal on its body glows. It looks for underground water in caves.
pokedexEntries.White: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.
pokedexEntries.White 2: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.
pokedexEntries.X: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
pokedexEntries.Y: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: When it is healthy, its core sticks out. Always facing the same way, it swiftly moves front to back and left to right.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its orange crystal is a mass of energy. Just one crystal fragment would provide enough fuel for a hundred dump trucks.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It explores caves in search of underground water. It's not comfortable around water, so this Pokemon takes great care in lapping it up.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The energy overflowing from its body has turned into orange crystals that are hard enough to smash diamonds.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its orange crystals are lumps of powerful energy. They're valuable, so Boldore is sometimes targeted for them.
pokedexEntries.Sword: If you see its orange crystals start to glow, be wary. It's about to fire off bursts of energy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.

pokedexEntries.Black: Compressing the energy from its internal core lets it fire off an attack capable of blowing away a mountain.
pokedexEntries.White: The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.
pokedexEntries.White 2: The solar rays it absorbs are processed in its energy core and fired as a ball of light.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When it fires off energy with all its might, the power creates countless fissures on its body.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It absorbs rays of sunlight and shoots out energy. It's usually lurking deep beneath the surface.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This hardy Pokemon can often be found on construction sites and in mines, working alongside people and Copperajah.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.

pokedexEntries.White: These Pokemon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

pokedexEntries.White: Riding whirlwinds, they appear. These Pokemon sneak through gaps into houses and cause all sorts of mischief.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.
pokedexEntries.White 2: They appear along with whirlwinds. They pull pranks, such as moving furniture and leaving balls of cotton in homes.

name: petilil
flavorText: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

pokedexEntries.Black: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
pokedexEntries.White: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.
pokedexEntries.White 2: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.
pokedexEntries.X: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
pokedexEntries.Y: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.
pokedexEntries.Moon: By pruning the leaves on its head with regularity, this Pokemon can be grown into a fine plump shape.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Some say if you dry the leaves on its head, boil them down, and drink the infusion, your vigor will return, so Petilil is popular with the elderly.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Petilil appears around sources of clean water. Boiling leaves from this Pokemon's head results in a liquid that's sometimes used as a bug repellent.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The deeper the color of a Petilil's leaves, the healthier the Pokemon is. Petilil sometimes makes its home in a well-tended field or flowerbed.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The leaves on its head grow right back even if they fall out. These bitter leaves refresh those who eat them.
pokedexEntries.Violet: If the leaves on its head are pruned with regularity, this Pokémon can be grown into a fine plump shape.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.
pokedexEntries.GO: The leaves on its head are very bitter. Eating one of these leaves is known to refresh a tired body.

name: lilligant

pokedexEntries.Black: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokemon is popular with celebrities.
pokedexEntries.White: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.
pokedexEntries.White 2: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.

pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokemon is popular with celebrities.
pokedexEntries.Sun: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.
pokedexEntries.Moon: As soon as it finds a male to be its partner, the beautiful flower on its head darkens, droops, and withers away.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The fragrance of its flower differs slightly depending on the soil where it grew up. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It's well liked by other Pokemon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It's believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant's head to bloom.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Essential oils made from Lilligant flowers have a sublime scent, but they're also staggeringly expensive.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect, but taking care of it is very difficult.
pokedexEntries.Violet: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.

name: basculin-red-striped
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.

pokedexEntries.Black: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.
pokedexEntries.White: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.White 2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.X: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.

pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Savage, violent Pokemon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That's how violent Basculin are.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Anglers love the fight this Pokemon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.
pokedexEntries.Shield: In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it's more popular with the youth.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Its temperament is vicious and aggressive. This Pokémon is also full of vitality and can multiply rapidly before anyone notices.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It's so vicious that it's called the Thug of the River. Yet Basculin is still targeted by predators, such as Dondozo and Bombirdier.

pokedexEntries.White: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

pokedexEntries.White 2: They live hidden under hot desert sands in order to keep their body temperature from dropping.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokemon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Sandile's still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It's called "the cleaner of the desert."
pokedexEntries.Sword: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokemon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Sandile is small, but its legs and lower body are powerful. Pushing sand aside as it goes, Sandile moves through the desert as if it's swimming.

pokedexEntries.White: About 100 million years ago, these Pokemon swam in oceans. It is thought they also went on land to attack prey.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: This Pokemon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.
pokedexEntries.White 2: This Pokemon was restored from a fossil. It swam skillfully and dove to depths beyond half a mile.

pokedexEntries.Black: They are intelligent and will cooperate to catch prey. From the ground, they use a running start to take flight.
pokedexEntries.White: It runs better than it flies. It catches prey by running at speeds comparable to those of an automobile.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.
pokedexEntries.White 2: It runs better than it flies. It takes off into the sky by running at a speed of 25 mph.

pokedexEntries.White: The combination of garbage bags and industrial waste caused the chemical reaction that created this Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.
pokedexEntries.White 2: Wanting more garbage, they follow people who litter. They always belch poison gas.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: If a young Pokemon or child breathes in the toxic gas that Trubbish belches out, it could be a life-threatening situation.

pokedexEntries.White: They absorb garbage and make it part of their bodies. They shoot a poisonous liquid from their right-hand fingertips.

pokedexEntries.White 2: Consuming garbage makes new kinds of poison gases and liquids inside their bodies.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Some say the reason Garbodor in Alola are a little stronger than their counterparts elsewhere is the presence of Muk, their natural enemy.

pokedexEntries.Shield: A combative Pokemon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: They pick fights indiscriminately. They grow stronger and more powerful each time they faint or are injured.
pokedexEntries.Violet: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it's a carnivore at heart.

pokedexEntries.Violet: It makes shuriken out of mucus excreted from its thighs. These shuriken can cut cleanly through steel cables.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
pokedexEntries.GO: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

name: bunnelby
flavorText: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

pokedexEntries.X: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
pokedexEntries.Y: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It has ears like shovels. Digging holes strengthens its ears so much that they can sever thick roots effortlessly.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

pokedexEntries.GO: They use their large ears to dig burrows. They will dig the whole night through.

flavorText: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.

pokedexEntries.X: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
pokedexEntries.Y: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: With their powerful ears, they can heft boulders of a ton or more with ease. They can be a big help at construction sites.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: As powerful as an excavator, its ears can reduce dense bedrock to rubble. When it's finished digging, it lounges lazily.
pokedexEntries.Sword: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.

name: fletchling
flavorText: These friendly Pokemon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

pokedexEntries.X: These friendly Pokemon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
pokedexEntries.Y: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: These friendly Pokemon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Despite the beauty of its lilting voice, it's merciless to intruders that enter its territory.
pokedexEntries.Sun: This amiable Pokemon is easy to train. But when battle is joined, it shows its ferocious side.
pokedexEntries.Moon: When it's excited, its temperature can double, spiking hormone production in its body.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: While it's an amiable Pokemon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When this Pokemon gets excited, its body temperature increases sharply. If you touch a Fletchling with bare hands, you might get burned.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon is normally calm, but once it enters battle, its hormonal balance changes and it becomes aggressive.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Fletchling can be found in both rural and urban areas. They once had a huge territorial dispute with Squawkabilly. Fights broke out all over town.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: These friendly Pokemon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.
pokedexEntries.GO: These friendly Pokemon send signals to one another with beautiful chirps and tail-feather movements.

name: fletchinder
flavorText: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

pokedexEntries.X: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
pokedexEntries.Y: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: The hotter the flame sac on its belly, the faster it can fly, but it takes some time to get the fire going.
pokedexEntries.Sun: From its beak, it fires embers at its prey. Once it has caught them, it grills them at high heat before feasting upon them.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It will not tolerate other Fletchinder entering its territory, which has a radius of several miles.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokemon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Fletchinder launches embers into the den of its prey. When the prey comes leaping out, Fletchinder's sharp talons finish it off.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Fletchinder are exceedingly territorial and aggressive. These Pokemon fight among themselves over feeding grounds.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Fletchinder scatters embers in tall grass where bug Pokémon might be hiding and then catches them as they come leaping out.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Its territory has a radius of just over a mile. If any bird Pokémon should enter, it will show them no mercy.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.
pokedexEntries.GO: From its beak, it expels embers that set the tall grass on fire. Then it pounces on the bewildered prey that pop out of the grass.

name: talonflame
flavorText: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

pokedexEntries.X: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
pokedexEntries.Y: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: When attacking prey, it can reach speeds of up to 310 mph. It finishes its prey off with a colossal kick.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its favorite foods are Wingull and Pikipek. It attacks with a powerful kick and grasps them firmly in its talons.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It zooms directly at its prey at flight speeds of close to 310 mph, while fiery embers scatter from gaps in its feathers.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Bird Pokemon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Talonflame mainly preys upon other bird Pokemon. To intimidate opponents, it sends embers spewing from gaps between its feathers.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Talonflame dives toward prey at speeds of up to 310 mph and assaults them with powerful kicks, giving the prey no chance to escape.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It has top-notch flying capabilities. It flies around easily, even while carrying prey that weighs more than 220 lbs.
pokedexEntries.Violet: When it gets excited, it vents sparks from the gaps between its feathers. These unburnable feathers are used as a fireproof material.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.
pokedexEntries.GO: In the fever of an exciting battle, it showers embers from the gaps between its feathers and takes to the air.

name: scatterbug
flavorText: When under attack from bird Pokemon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

pokedexEntries.X: When under attack from bird Pokemon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
pokedexEntries.Y: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: When under attack from bird Pokemon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Any poison this Pokémon takes in is converted into a black powder and secreted. That's why Scatterbug can eat poisonous leaves and roots.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder to repel enemies. It will eat different plants depending on where it lives.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When under attack from bird Pokemon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
pokedexEntries.GO: When under attack from bird Pokemon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.

name: spewpa
flavorText: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.

pokedexEntries.X: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
pokedexEntries.Y: The beaks of bird Pokemon can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: The beaks of bird Pokemon can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: If Rufflet attacks this Pokémon by pecking at it, it will retaliate with its sharp fur and poisonous black powder.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Spewpa doesn't live in a fixed location. It roams where it pleases across the fields and mountains, building up the energy it needs to evolve.

name: vivillon
flavorText: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.

pokedexEntries.X: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
pokedexEntries.Y: The patterns on this Pokemon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: The patterns on this Pokemon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The patterns on this Pokémon depend on the climate and topography of the land it was born in. This form is from frigid lands.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon was born in frigid lands. It scatters colorful, toxic scales from its wings during battle.

name: litleo
flavorText: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

pokedexEntries.X: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
pokedexEntries.Y: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokemon are quick to fight.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: They set off on their own from their pride and live by themselves to become stronger. These hot-blooded Pokemon are quick to fight.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: This hot-blooded Pokemon is filled with curiosity. When it gets angry or starts fighting, its short mane gets hot.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: When Litleo are young, female Pyroar will teach them how to hunt. Once the Litleo mature, they will leave the pride and set out on their own.
pokedexEntries.Violet: The more a Litleo trains its body and spirit by battling mighty enemies, the hotter its mane will grow.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.
pokedexEntries.GO: The stronger the opponent it faces, the more heat surges from its mane and the more power flows through its body.

name: pyroar-male
flavorText: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

pokedexEntries.X: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
pokedexEntries.Y: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: With fiery breath of more than 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, they viciously threaten any challenger. The females protect the pride's cubs.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The temperature of its breath is over 10,000 degrees Fahrenheit, but Pyroar doesn't use it on its prey. This Pokemon prefers to eat raw meat.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The females of a pride work together to bring down prey. It's thanks to them that their pride doesn't starve.
pokedexEntries.Violet: The mane of a male Pyroar heats up to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit during battle. Merely approaching it will cause severe burns.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.
pokedexEntries.GO: The male with the largest mane of fire is the leader of the pride.

name: flabebe
flavorText: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

pokedexEntries.X: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
pokedexEntries.Y: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: When it finds a flower it likes, it dwells on that flower its whole life long. It floats in the wind's embrace with an untroubled heart.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon can draw forth the power hidden within blooming wild flowers. It is particularly fond of red flowers.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.
pokedexEntries.GO: It draws out and controls the hidden power of flowers. The flower Flabébé holds is most likely part of its body.

name: floette
flavorText: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

pokedexEntries.X: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
pokedexEntries.Y: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon draws forth what power is left in withered flowers to make them healthy again. It holds a red flower.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
pokedexEntries.GO: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: florges
flavorText: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

pokedexEntries.X: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
pokedexEntries.Y: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: In times long past, governors of castles would invite Florges to create flower gardens to embellish the castle domains.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon creates an impressive flower garden in its territory. It draws forth the power of the red flowers around its neck.
pokedexEntries.Violet: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.
pokedexEntries.GO: It claims exquisite flower gardens as its territory, and it obtains power from basking in the energy emitted by flowering plants.

name: skiddo
flavorText: Thought to be one of the first Pokemon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

pokedexEntries.X: Thought to be one of the first Pokemon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
pokedexEntries.Y: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Thought to be one of the first Pokemon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn't need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Until recently, people living in the mountains would ride on the backs of these Pokémon to traverse the mountain paths.
pokedexEntries.Violet: As long as it has sunlight and water, Skiddo can make energy with the leaves on its body, allowing it to live on rocky mountains barren of food.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Thought to be one of the first Pokemon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
pokedexEntries.GO: Thought to be one of the first Pokemon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.

name: gogoat
flavorText: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.

pokedexEntries.Violet: These Pokémon live in herds in mountainous places. The victor in their contests of clashing horns will become the leader of the herd.

name: pancham
flavorText: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

pokedexEntries.X: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
pokedexEntries.Y: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can't help grinning if anyone pats its head.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
pokedexEntries.Moon: There's no point to the leaf in its mouth, aside from an effort to look cool. It's mischievous, so it's not well suited to inexperienced Trainers.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It's desperate to intimidate its opponents. Be nice and pretend to be scared if you catch it glaring at you intensely.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.

pokedexEntries.GO: It does its best to be taken seriously by its enemies, but its glare is not sufficiently intimidating. Chewing on a leaf is its trademark.

name: pangoro
flavorText: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.

pokedexEntries.Y: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Although it possesses a violent temperament, it won't put up with bullying. It uses the leaf in its mouth to sense the movements of its enemies.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It charges ahead and bashes its opponents like a berserker, uncaring about any hits it might take. Its arms are mighty enough to snap a telephone pole.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Pangoro is the type to talk with its fists. It doesn't say much as it pummels opponents with enough force to send a dump truck flying.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.

name: furfrou
flavorText: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.

pokedexEntries.X: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
pokedexEntries.Y: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokemon were the designated guardians of the king.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Historically, in the Kalos region, these Pokemon were the designated guardians of the king.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: There was an era when aristocrats would compete to see who could trim their Furfrou's fur into the most exquisite style.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Left alone, its fur will grow longer and longer, but it will only allow someone it trusts to cut it.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Trimming its fluffy fur not only makes it more elegant but also increases the swiftness of its movements.
