pokedexEntries.Scarlet: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.
pokedexEntries.Violet: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
pokedexEntries.GO: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.

name: torracat
flavorText: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokemon spits fire.

pokedexEntries.Sun: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokemon spits fire.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It boasts powerful front legs. With a single punch, it can bend an iron bar right over.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokemon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When its mane is standing on end, you can tell it's feeling good. When it isn't feeling well, its fur will lie down flat.
pokedexEntries.Sword: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat's neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When facing a powerful enemy, Torracat's fighting spirit gets pumped up, and its fire bell blazes hotter.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever fire spews out.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Torracat will let its Trainer coddle it once they've grown close, but it's a powerful, sharp-clawed Pokémon, so its Trainer gets covered in scratches.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokemon spits fire.
pokedexEntries.GO: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokemon spits fire.

name: incineroar
flavorText: This Pokemon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This Pokemon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.
pokedexEntries.Moon: After hurling ferocious punches and flinging furious kicks, it finishes opponents off by spewing fire from around its navel.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It excels at violent, no-holds-barred battles. The temperature of the flames that issue from its navel exceeds 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Incineroar's rough and aggressive behavior is its most notable trait, but the way it helps out small Pokemon shows that it has a kind side as well.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: When its fighting spirit is set alight, the flames around its waist become especially intense.
pokedexEntries.Violet: After hurling ferocious punches and flinging furious kicks, it finishes opponents off by spewing fire from around its navel.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: This Pokemon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.
pokedexEntries.GO: This Pokemon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.

name: popplio
flavorText: This Pokemon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This Pokemon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon can control water bubbles. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big bubbles.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Popplio gets on top of its bouncy water balloons to jump higher. It's quite the acrobatic fighter!
pokedexEntries.Sword: It creates special bouncy balloons to send at its opponents. When the balloons pop, the sheer force of their bursting is what deals damage.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If Popplio want to create big, powerful balloons, they must be persistent. It takes daily practice for these Pokemon to develop their skills.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon can control balloons made of water. It practices diligently so it can learn to make big balloons.
pokedexEntries.Violet: The balloons it inflates with its nose grow larger and larger as it practices day by day.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: This Pokemon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.
pokedexEntries.GO: This Pokemon snorts body fluids from its nose, blowing balloons to smash into its foes. It's famous for being a hard worker.

name: brionne
flavorText: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

pokedexEntries.Sun: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try and help.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It gets excited when it sees a dance it doesn't know. This hard worker practices diligently until it can learn that dance.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It attacks by smacking its enemies with the exploding water balloons that it creates.
pokedexEntries.Sword: As if dancing, it artfully dodges the attacks of its enemies. All the while, it's busy forming a bunch of balloons to overwhelm its foes.
pokedexEntries.Shield: On nights when the sea is calm, Brionne dance with one another to the singing of the Primarina that's leading them.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, then briskly bombards its enemies.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It cares deeply for its companions. When its Trainer is feeling down, it performs a cheery dance to try to help.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.
pokedexEntries.GO: A skillful dancer, it creates a sequence of water balloons as it dances, and briskly bombards its enemies.

name: primarina
flavorText: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its singing voice is its chief weapon in battle. This Pokemon's Trainer must prioritize the daily maintenance of its throat at all costs.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Also known as a songstress, it has a fantastical look on moonlit nights when it leads its colony in song.
pokedexEntries.Sword: With its mouth, it makes sonic waves that sound like beautiful singing. It uses the sonic waves to control its water balloons.
pokedexEntries.Shield: For Primarina, every battle's a stage. Its singing and the dancing of its balloons will mesmerize the audience.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: To Primarina, every battle is a stage. It takes down its prey with beautiful singing and dancing.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Also known as a songstress, it is a sight to behold on moonlit nights when it sings in front of the colony it leads.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.
pokedexEntries.GO: It controls its water balloons with song. The melody is learned from others of its kind and is passed down from one generation to the next.

name: pikipek
flavorText: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon feeds on berries, whose leftover seeds become the ammunition for the attacks it fires off from its mouth.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It pecks at trees with its hard beak. You can get some idea of its mood or condition from the rhythm of its pecking.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Using its beak to strike 16 times per second, it opens holes in even the hardest of trees.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Pikipek has strong muscles in its neck, so it won't hurt itself even if it violently shakes its head.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.
pokedexEntries.GO: It can peck at a rate of 16 times a second to drill holes in trees. It uses the holes for food storage and for nesting.

name: trumbeak
flavorText: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
pokedexEntries.Moon: By bending its beak, it can produce a variety of calls and brand itself a noisy nuisance for its neighbors.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It can bend the tip of its beak to produce over a hundred different cries at will.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It flies around using a hundred different cries in various ways to declare its territory to others.
pokedexEntries.Violet: When it encounters foes, it launches the many seeds stored in its beak in a radial burst.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.
pokedexEntries.GO: It eats berries and stores their seeds in its beak. When it encounters enemies or prey, it fires off all the seeds in a burst.

name: toucannon
flavorText: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

pokedexEntries.Sun: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Within its beak, its internal gas ignites, explosively launching seeds with enough power to pulverize boulders.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: They smack beaks with others of their kind to communicate. The strength and number of hits tell each other how they feel.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokemon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The compressed gas in Toucannon's beak launches seeds with such force that they can shatter large boulders.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Pairs of Toucannon are considered symbols of companionship, as these Pokémon will raise the temperature of their beaks to warm each other.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it battles, its beak heats up. The temperature can easily exceed 212 degrees Fahrenheit, causing severe burns when it hits.

name: yungoos
flavorText: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

pokedexEntries.Sun: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It wanders around in a never-ending search for food. At dusk, it collapses from exhaustion and falls asleep on the spot.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although it will eat anything, it prefers fresh living things, so it marches down streets in search of prey.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Its stomach fills most of its torso. It wanders the same path every day, searching for fresh food.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It spends its waking hours searching endlessly for food. When Yungoos is hungry, its ferocity gains a certain edge.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.
pokedexEntries.GO: With its sharp fangs, it will bite anything. It did not originally live in Alola but was imported from another region.

name: gumshoos
flavorText: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

pokedexEntries.Sun: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokemon boasts incredible patience.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokemon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Patient by nature, this Pokemon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Once it finds signs of prey, it will patiently stake out the location, waiting until the sun goes down.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Gumshoos specializes in relentlessly tracking down prey. The simple-minded Skwovet doesn't seem to provide Gumshoos enough challenge.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

name: grubbin
flavorText: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
pokedexEntries.Moon: They often gather near places frequented by electric Pokemon in order to avoid being attacked by bird Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: If you find its nest, you shouldn't stick your hand inside. You'll get bitten by an irritated Grubbin.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It spits a sticky thread to stop opponents in their tracks, and then it grabs them in its sharp, sturdy mandibles to take them down.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Grubbin normally live underground, but if they get unearthed by Hoothoot, they may be found gathered around electric Pokémon.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It spits sticky threads and winds them around branches, then swings nimbly from tree to tree in a pendulum-like motion.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its strong jaw enables it to scrape trees and slurp out the sap. It normally lives underground.

name: charjabug
flavorText: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
pokedexEntries.Moon: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.
pokedexEntries.Sword: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Protected by a sturdy shell, Charjabug eats large quantities of fresh and decomposing leaf litter in order to evolve.
pokedexEntries.Violet: As it digests fallen leaves, it generates and stores electricity, which it can discharge from the tips of its jaws.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

name: vikavolt
flavorText: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokemon with shocking beams of electrical energy.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Displaying exceptional mobility, it weaves between trees and shoots down bird Pokémon with its electromagnetic beams.
pokedexEntries.Violet: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
pokedexEntries.GO: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

name: crabrawler
flavorText: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

pokedexEntries.Sun: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It punches so much, its pincers often come off from overuse, but they grow back quickly. What little meat they contain is rich and delicious.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon punches trees and eats the berries that drop down, training itself and getting food at the same time.
pokedexEntries.Violet: If it loses its pincers, they'll quickly regrow. The pincers are popular ingredients in paella since their shells produce a tasty soup stock.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
pokedexEntries.GO: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

name: crabominable
flavorText: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokemon evolved and grew fur.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokemon evolved and grew fur.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It just throws punches indiscriminately. In times of desperation, it can lop off its own pincers and fire them like rockets.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The detached pincers of these Pokémon are delicious. Some Trainers bring Lechonk into the mountains just to search for them.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon's movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles from its mouth to immobilize its opponents.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokemon evolved and grew fur.
pokedexEntries.GO: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokemon evolved and grew fur.

name: oricorio-baile
flavorText: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokemon becomes fiercely angry.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon is incredibly popular, possibly because its passionate dancing is a great match with the temperament of Paldean people.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This form of Oricorio has sipped red nectar. It whips up blazing flames as it moves to the steps of its passionate dance.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
pokedexEntries.GO: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: cutiefly
flavorText: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Myriads of Cutiefly flutter above the heads of people who have auras resembling those of flowers.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. In fields of flowers, it gets into skirmishes with Butterfree over food.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Cutiefly can pick up the auras of living things. It skillfully reads those auras to predict its foes' movements and make fools of them.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.
pokedexEntries.Shield: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: When it senses the auras of people or Pokémon who are having fun, it will draw close and give them a painful poke with its long proboscis.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Cutiefly sucks up pollen and nectar with its long proboscis. It stores any pollen it doesn't finish eating in its fur.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
pokedexEntries.GO: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

name: ribombee
flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Ribombee can sense when people or Pokémon are feeling down, and it will cheer them up with handmade pollen puffs.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Pollen puffs created by skilled Ribombee can relieve fatigue, making the puffs a popular commodity.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
pokedexEntries.GO: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: rockruff
flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokemon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It's considered to be a good Pokemon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon travels in a pack with others until it grows up. When its mood turns sour, it starts striking the ground with the rocks on its neck.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It's considered to be a good Pokemon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
pokedexEntries.GO: It's considered to be a good Pokemon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: lycanroc-midday
flavorText: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
pokedexEntries.Moon: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.
pokedexEntries.Shield: With swift movements, this Pokemon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It has a calm and collected demeanor. It swiftly closes in on its prey, then slices them with the rocks in its mane.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: wishiwashi-solo
flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

pokedexEntries.Sun: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: They're weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: mareanie
flavorText: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's found crawling on beaches and seafloors. The coral that grows on Corsola's head is as good as a five-star banquet to this Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Aside from its head, its body parts regenerate quickly if they're cut off. After a good night's sleep, Mareanie is back to normal.
pokedexEntries.Sword: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Unlike their Alolan counterparts, the Mareanie of the Galar region have not yet figured out that the branches of Corsola are delicious.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon wanders the seaside looking for food. It often gets electric shocks from broken Pincurchin spines that it tries to eat.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It has excellent regenerative capabilities. Legs that a Mareanie has lost have a very bitter, astringent flavor-they're not suitable as food.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
pokedexEntries.GO: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.

name: toxapex
flavorText: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Those attacked by Toxapex's poison will suffer intense pain for three days and three nights. Post-recovery, there will be some aftereffects.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: To attack, this Pokemon sends toxic spikes flying at its enemies. Ones that come close get mown down by the claws on its feet.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: With its 12 legs, it creates a dome to shelter within. The flow of the tides doesn't affect Toxapex in there, so it's very comfortable.
pokedexEntries.Sword: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokemon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Within the poison sac in its body is a poison so toxic that Pokemon as large as Wailord will still be suffering three days after it first takes effect.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon lives within a dome made by its own legs. Toxapex monitors its surroundings by sensing the flow of the tide through its spikes.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Toxapex gets into fierce battles with Bruxish over areas where warm ocean currents flow, but the odds are always against it.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.
pokedexEntries.GO: Toxapex crawls along the ocean floor on its 12 legs. It leaves a trail of Corsola bits scattered in its wake.

name: mudbray
flavorText: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

pokedexEntries.Sun: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It has a stubborn, individualistic disposition. Eating dirt, making mud, and playing in the mire all form part of its daily routine.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It loves playing in the mud. If it isn't showered with mud on a daily basis, it gets stressed out and stops listening to its Trainer.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Possessing mighty power, Mudbray can be loaded with 50 times its own body weight and will be totally fine.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokemon. It's skilled at making use of mud.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It eats dirt to create mud and smears this mud all over its feet, giving them the grip needed to walk on rough terrain without slipping.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won't dry out even if it's exposed to the sun for a long time.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Though a slow walker, Mudbray is plenty strong. Its pace doesn't change even when it's loaded with 50 times its own body weight.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
pokedexEntries.GO: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

name: mudsdale
flavorText: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its heavy, mud-covered kicks are its best means of attack, and it can reduce large trucks to scrap without breaking a sweat.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It remains calm and unmoving no matter the situation. It mixes dirt with the saliva in its mouth to make a special kind of mud.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It can trudge mountain roads without rest for three days and three nights, all the while dragging a 10-ton load.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokemon to scrap a truck with a single kick.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Mudsdale has so much stamina that it could carry over 10 tons across the Galar region without rest or sleep.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Its legs are fortified with mud and harder than stone, and they can reduce a large truck to scrap with one kick.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
pokedexEntries.GO: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

name: dewpider
flavorText: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
pokedexEntries.Moon: When it comes across enemies or potential prey, this Pokemon smashes its water-bubble-covered head into them.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It can only breathe oxygen that has dissolved in water, so it wears a water bubble on its head when it walks around on land.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Dewpider uses sticky threads to create the water bubble that covers its head, so the bubble very rarely bursts.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It supports the water bubble that envelops its head with three of its legs. Sometimes it secretly swaps which legs are holding up the bubble.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.
pokedexEntries.GO: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

name: araquanid
flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokemon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokemon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokemon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn't watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!
pokedexEntries.Sword: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokemon can then take its time to savor its meal.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: A caring Pokémon, Araquanid carries Dewpider around inside its water bubble to protect them as it walks. It protects its food in its bubble too.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It launches sticky water bubbles. Foes who lose consciousness while trapped inside these bubbles will get torn apart by Araquanid's gnashing jaws.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokemon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
pokedexEntries.GO: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokemon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: fomantis
flavorText: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

pokedexEntries.Sun: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
pokedexEntries.Moon: They give off a sweet and refreshing scent. Cutiefly often gather near the tall grass where Fomantis are hiding.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.
pokedexEntries.Sword: When bathed in sunlight, this Pokemon emits a pleasantly sweet scent, which causes bug Pokemon to gather around it.
pokedexEntries.Shield: During the day, Fomantis basks in sunlight and sleeps peacefully. It wakes and moves around at night.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Fomantis hates having its naps interrupted. It fires off beams using energy it gathers by bathing in the sun.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Many Trainers give their Fomantis their own flowerpots so they can sunbathe in peace and quiet.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.
pokedexEntries.GO: During the day, it sleeps and soaks up light. When night falls, it walks around looking for a safer place to sleep.

name: lurantis
flavorText: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It fires beams from its sickle-shaped petals. These beams are powerful enough to cleave through thick metal plates.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokemon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The petals on this Pokemon's arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: By masquerading as a bug Pokémon, it lowers the guard of actual bug Pokémon lured in by a scent of sweet flowers. Its sickles bring them down.
pokedexEntries.Violet: A lot of time and effort is required to maintain the vivid colors of its petals. This Pokémon puts its Trainer's attentiveness to the test.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
pokedexEntries.GO: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

name: morelull
flavorText: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
pokedexEntries.Moon: As it drowses the day away, it nourishes itself by sucking from tree roots. It wakens at the fall of night, wandering off in search of a new tree.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It likes damp dark places. When night falls, the spores filling the caps of its mushrooms glow.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Pokemon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Morelull live in forests that stay dark even during the day. They scatter flickering spores that put enemies to sleep.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
pokedexEntries.GO: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

name: shiinotic
flavorText: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It emits flickering spores that cause drowsiness. When its prey succumb to sleep, this Pokemon feeds on them by sucking in their energy.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It puts its prey to sleep and siphons off their vitality through the tip of its arms. If one of its kind is weakened, it helps by sending it vitality.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When it starts fighting for territory with Parasect, the entire area gets completely coated in spores!
pokedexEntries.Sword: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokemon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If you see a light deep in a forest at night, don't go near. Shiinotic will make you fall fast asleep.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
pokedexEntries.GO: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.

name: salandit
flavorText: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Volcanoes or dry, craggy places are its home. It emanates a sweet-smelling poisonous gas that attracts bug Pokemon, then attacks them.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It weakens opponents and sends them reeling with its poisonous gas. Salandit doesn't deal well with Spinda, since it's always reeling.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokemon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This sneaky Pokemon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It taunts its prey and lures them into narrow, rocky areas where it then sprays them with toxic gas to make them dizzy and take them down.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Only female Salandit can produce gas laden with pheromones. Males entranced by this gas will do whatever the females tell them.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.
pokedexEntries.GO: It burns its bodily fluids to create a poisonous gas. When its enemies become disoriented from inhaling the gas, it attacks them.

name: salazzle
flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

pokedexEntries.Sun: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It punishes Salandit that couldn't bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Salazzle makes its opponents light-headed with poisonous gas, then captivates them with alluring movements to turn them into loyal servants.
pokedexEntries.Violet: When two Salazzle meet, they will use their pheromone gas to fight over the males in each other's group.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
pokedexEntries.GO: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: stufful
flavorText: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
pokedexEntries.Moon: A touch from anyone except a known friend sends it into a surging frenzy. It's an incredibly dangerous Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Stufful hates to be hugged or touched in any way. It will squirm, thrash, and resist with amazing power.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Its fluffy fur is a delight to pet, but carelessly reaching out to touch this Pokemon could result in painful retaliation.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.
pokedexEntries.GO: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

name: bewear
flavorText: This immensely dangerous Pokemon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This immensely dangerous Pokemon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon has the habit of hugging its companions. Many Trainers have left this world after their spines were squashed by its hug.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It boasts tremendous physical strength. Many people call it the most dangerous Pokemon in the Alola region.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Once it accepts you as a friend, it tries to show its affection with a hug. Letting it do that is dangerous—it could easily shatter your bones.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: This immensely dangerous Pokemon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: This immensely dangerous Pokemon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: This immensely dangerous Pokemon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.
pokedexEntries.GO: This immensely dangerous Pokemon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

name: bounsweet
flavorText: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

pokedexEntries.Sun: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Although it's too sugary for human consumption, Bounsweet's sweat can be watered down into a juice with just the right amount of sweetness.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokemon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It tries to resist being swallowed by a bird Pokemon by spinning the sepals on its head. It's usually a fruitless attempt.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When under attack, it secretes a sweet and delicious sweat. The scent only calls more enemies to it.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled- down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.
pokedexEntries.Violet: A Greedent drawn in by the sweet scent of these Pokémon will tuck the Bounsweet in among the berries in its tail and carry them all away.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.
pokedexEntries.GO: A delectable aroma pours from its body. They are often swallowed whole by Toucannon lured by that wafting deliciousness.

name: steenee
flavorText: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokemon, this Pokemon is totally fine.

pokedexEntries.Sun: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokemon, this Pokemon is totally fine.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon is always bouncing around energetically. Other Pokemon are attracted by its lively appearance and pleasant aroma.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokemon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It bounces around, swinging the sepals on its head with abandon. They're quite painful when they smack you!
pokedexEntries.Sword: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Any Corvisquire that pecks at this Pokemon will be greeted with a smack from its sepals followed by a sharp kick.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Steenee bounces energetically through forests. If the rind that peels off its body is pulverized, it can be used to treat stomach pains.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokemon, this Pokemon is totally fine.
pokedexEntries.GO: The sepals on its head developed to protect its body. These are quite hard, so even if pecked by bird Pokemon, this Pokemon is totally fine.

name: tsareena
flavorText: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
pokedexEntries.Moon: A Pokemon known for the beauty of its well-shaped legs, it sometimes appears as a mascot in advertisements for beauty salons.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: A master of grand and beautiful kicks, it can knock out even kickboxing champions with a single blow.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: A Pokemon with an aggressive personality and a mastery of kicking, it cackles every time it kicks an opponent.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This feared Pokemon has long, slender legs and a cruel heart. It shows no mercy as it stomps on its opponents.
pokedexEntries.Shield: A kick from the hardened tips of this Pokemon's legs leaves a wound in the opponent's body and soul that will never heal.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon is proud and aggressive. However, it is said that a Tsareena will instantly become calm if someone touches the crown on its calyx.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon launches fierce yet elegant kicks with its long, slender legs. It views Quaquaval as its rival.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its long, striking legs aren't just for show but to be used to kick with skill. In victory, it shows off by kicking the defeated, laughing boisterously.

name: comfey
flavorText: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Baths prepared with the flowers from its vine have a relaxing effect, so this Pokemon is a hit with many people.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It stretches sticky vines out from its head and picks flowers to adorn itself with. When it doesn't have any flowers, it feels uneasy.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It picks flowers and sticks them to its body with fluids it produces. The aroma that wafts from its petals has a healing effect.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.
pokedexEntries.Shield: These Pokemon smell very nice. All Comfey wear different flowers, so each of these Pokemon has its own individual scent.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It uses its vine to pick flowers. The flowers that Comfey attaches to itself develop healing properties.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It prefers areas with lots of flowers. A Comfey adorned with flowers is a happy Comfey, and the flowers gain healing effects.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
pokedexEntries.GO: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.

name: oranguru
flavorText: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokemon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokemon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Deep in the jungle, high in the lofty canopy, this Pokemon abides. On rare occasions, it shows up at the beach to match wits with Slowking.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokemon orders as it pleases.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Oranguru don't get along with each other, so they're always engaging in battles of wits to decide which one is superior.
pokedexEntries.Sword: With waves of its fan—made from leaves and its own fur—Oranguru skillfully gives instructions to other Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokemon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: People used to mistake Oranguru for a human when they saw it issue command after command to the other Pokémon of the forest.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon lives quietly in the depths of the forest. The purple, cape-like fur gets longer and longer as Oranguru ages.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokemon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.
pokedexEntries.GO: Known for its extreme intelligence, this Pokemon will look down on inexperienced Trainers, so it's best suited to veteran Trainers.

name: passimian
flavorText: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

pokedexEntries.Sun: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
pokedexEntries.Moon: They battle with hard berries for weapons. Their techniques are passed from the boss to the group, generation upon generation.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Berries are its weapons as well as the staple of its diet. The one that can throw a berry the farthest is the boss of the troop.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon battles by throwing hard berries. It won't obey a Trainer who throws Poké Balls without skill.
pokedexEntries.Violet: The boss chooses 10 members of the group to go out hunting. The hunting party will evenly split the food they find with the rest of the group.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
pokedexEntries.GO: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

name: wimpod
flavorText: This Pokemon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This Pokemon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its habitat varies from beaches to seabeds. A natural scavenger, it will gleefully chow down on anything edible, no matter how rotten.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: An astonishingly cowardly Pokemon, Wimpod will whir its legs at high speeds to run away if anything comes near it.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It's nature's cleaner—it eats anything and everything, including garbage and rotten things. The ground near its nest is always clean.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: This Pokemon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: This Pokemon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: This Pokemon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
pokedexEntries.GO: This Pokemon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

name: golisopod
flavorText: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

pokedexEntries.Sun: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It battles skillfully with its six arms, but spends most of its time peacefully meditating in caves deep beneath the sea.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokemon will do anything it takes to win.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its claws, which it can extend and retract at will, are its greatest weapons. Golisopod is sometimes accompanied by Wimpod.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It will do anything to win, taking advantage of every opening and finishing opponents off with the small claws on its front legs.
pokedexEntries.Shield: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner's meal.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
pokedexEntries.GO: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.

name: sandygast
flavorText: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokemon embodies the grudges of the departed.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokemon embodies the grudges of the departed.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It takes control of anyone who puts a hand in its mouth. And so it adds to the accumulation of its sand-mound body.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokemon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Sandygast mainly inhabits beaches. It takes control of anyone who puts their hand into its mouth, forcing them to make its body bigger.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: If it loses its shovel, it will stick something else- like a branch-in its head to make do until it finds another shovel.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they're blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokemon embodies the grudges of the departed.
pokedexEntries.GO: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokemon embodies the grudges of the departed.

name: palossand
flavorText: Possessed people controlled by this Pokemon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Possessed people controlled by this Pokemon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Buried beneath the castle are masses of dried-up bones from those whose vitality it has drained.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokemon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokemon snatches away their vitality.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon lives on beaches, but it hates water. Palossand can't maintain its castle-like shape if it gets drenched by a heavy rain.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The terrifying Palossand drags smaller Pokémon into its sandy body. Once its victims are trapped, it drains them of their vitality whenever it pleases.
pokedexEntries.Violet: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Possessed people controlled by this Pokemon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
pokedexEntries.GO: Possessed people controlled by this Pokemon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

name: pyukumuku
flavorText: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

pokedexEntries.Shield: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
pokedexEntries.Moon: These Pokemon line the beaches. The sticky mucous that covers their bodies can be used to soothe sunburned skin. How convenient!
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its entire body is covered in its own slime. If you accidentally step on one, you'll slip, and it will get mad and smack you!
pokedexEntries.Sword: It lives in warm, shallow waters. If it encounters a foe, it will spit out its internal organs as a means to punch them.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.
pokedexEntries.GO: It lives in shallow seas, such as areas near a beach. It can eject its internal organs, which it uses to engulf its prey or battle enemies.

name: type-null
flavorText: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokemon has some hidden special power.

pokedexEntries.Sun: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokemon has some hidden special power.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Due to the danger that this synthetic Pokemon may go on a rampage, it wears a control mask to restrain its power.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: A Pokemon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: There's danger of its going on a rampage, so its true power is sealed away beneath its control mask.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Rumor has it that the theft of top-secret research notes led to a new instance of this Pokemon being created in the Galar region.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It was modeled after a mighty Pokemon of myth. The mask placed upon it limits its power in order to keep it under control.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokemon has some hidden special power.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokemon has some hidden special power.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokemon has some hidden special power.
pokedexEntries.GO: The heavy control mask it wears suppresses its intrinsic capabilities. This Pokemon has some hidden special power.

name: silvally
flavorText: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokemon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
