pokedexEntries.Sun: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokemon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Although its name was Type: Null at first, the boy who evolved it into this form gave it the name by which it is now known.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Through the bond it formed with its Trainer, its will was strengthened, and it was able to destroy its control mask.
pokedexEntries.Sword: A solid bond of trust between this Pokemon and its Trainer awakened the strength hidden within Silvally. It can change its type at will.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The final factor needed to release this Pokemon's true power was a strong bond with a Trainer it trusts.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokemon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokemon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokemon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its trust in its partner is what awakens it. This Pokemon is capable of changing its type, a flexibility that is well displayed in battle.

name: minior-red-meteor
flavorText: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Strong impacts can knock it out of its shell. This Pokemon was born from mutated nanoparticles.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokemon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon is born in the ozone layer. It falls to the ground once the outer shell enclosing its core grows heavy.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It will react when touched or called to, but it's unknown whether such responses indicate consciousness.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
pokedexEntries.GO: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

name: komala
flavorText: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The log it holds was given to it by its parents at birth. It has also been known to cling to the arm of a friendly Trainer.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It remains asleep from birth to death as a result of the sedative properties of the leaves that form its diet.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Komala spends its entire life sleeping. It feeds on leaves that contain a potent poison only Komala can break down.
pokedexEntries.Violet: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala's drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.
pokedexEntries.GO: It is born asleep, and it dies asleep. All its movements are apparently no more than the results of it tossing and turning in its dreams.

name: turtonator
flavorText: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

pokedexEntries.Sun: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It gushes fire and poisonous gases from its nostrils. Its dung is an explosive substance and can be put to various uses.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It lives in volcanoes and eats sulfur and other minerals. Materials from the food it eats form the basis of its explosive shell.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its exploding shell poses a real danger but is sensitive to moisture. On rainy days, Turtonator takes silent refuge in caves.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
pokedexEntries.GO: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

name: togedemaru
flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

pokedexEntries.Sun: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!
pokedexEntries.Sword: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokemon takes in electricity from other electric Pokemon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
pokedexEntries.GO: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: mimikyu-disguised
flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
pokedexEntries.Moon: A lonely Pokemon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokemon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokemon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.
pokedexEntries.Shield: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu's old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Mimikyu was only recently identified as a Pokémon. Previously, people thought it was just a ghost wearing a cloth.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: bruxish
flavorText: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

pokedexEntries.Sun: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It stuns its prey with psychokinesis and then grinds them to mush with its strong teeth. Even Shellder's shell is no match for it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It burrows beneath the sand, radiating psychic power from the protuberance on its head. It waits for prey as it surveys the area.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It grinds its teeth with great force to stimulate its brain. It fires the psychic energy created by this process from the protuberance on its head.
pokedexEntries.Violet: When sunlight reflects on the ripples created by a Bruxish grinding its teeth, the water all around sparkles brilliantly.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

name: drampa
flavorText: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon is friendly to people and loves children most of all. It comes from deep in the mountains to play with children it likes in town.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It appears in towns and plays with the children. Drampa will protect kids when they're in danger, so their moms don't have to worry.
pokedexEntries.Sword: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokemon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.

name: dhelmise
flavorText: Swinging its massive anchor, it can ko Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Swinging its massive anchor, it can ko Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The soul of seaweed adrift in the waves became reborn as this Pokemon. It maintains itself with new infusions of seabed detritus and seaweed.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its chain-like green seaweed can stretch outward for hundreds of yards. For some reason, it gets along well with Skrelp.
pokedexEntries.Sword: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Shield: After lowering its anchor, it waits for its prey. It catches large Wailord and drains their life-force.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Swinging its massive anchor, it can ko Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Swinging its massive anchor, it can ko Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Swinging its massive anchor, it can ko Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
pokedexEntries.GO: Swinging its massive anchor, it can ko Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.

name: jangmo-o
flavorText: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
pokedexEntries.Moon: They live in mountains where no trace of humans can be detected. Jangmo-o grow little by little as they battle one another.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It will never show an enemy its back in battle. Ancient warriors liked Jangmo-o for its valiant disposition and made it one of their own.
pokedexEntries.Sword: They learn to fight by smashing their head scales together. The dueling strengthens both their skills and their spirits.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Jangmo-o strikes its scales to communicate with others of its kind. Its scales are actually fur that's become as hard as metal.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The scale atop its head is useful for both offense and defense. It bravely stands and faces its foes rather than turning tail, even if its foes are strong.
pokedexEntries.Violet: They communicate with their allies using the sounds their scales make when struck. A group of these Pokémon causes quite a racket.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
pokedexEntries.GO: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.

name: hakamo-o
flavorText: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It sheds and regrows its scales on a continuous basis. The scales become harder and sharper each time they're regrown.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The scales it sheds can be molded and processed to make pots and pans. They conduct heat well, so they're a popular item.
pokedexEntries.Sword: The scaleless, scarred parts of its body are signs of its strength. It shows them off to defeated opponents.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Before attacking its enemies, it clashes its scales together and roars. Its sharp claws shred the opposition.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It gets into fistfights so intense that the scales on its arms peel off. Bare arms are a sign of valiance.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
pokedexEntries.GO: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.

name: kommo-o
flavorText: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

pokedexEntries.Sun: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokemon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It lets its arm hang, and then-quick as a flash- swings upward to land its specialty punch and send the opponent flying high into the sky.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It bashes its scales to test its opponents' mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

name: tapu-koko
flavorText: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It confuses its enemies by flying too quickly for the eye to follow. It has a hair-trigger temper but forgets what made it angry an instant later.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokemon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.
pokedexEntries.GO: This guardian deity of Melemele is brimming with curiosity. It summons thunderclouds and stores their lightning inside its body.

name: tapu-lele
flavorText: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
pokedexEntries.Moon: As it flutters about, it scatters its strangely glowing scales. Touching them is said to restore good health on the spot.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It heals the wounds of people and Pokemon by sprinkling them with its sparkling scales. This guardian deity is worshiped on Akala.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.
pokedexEntries.GO: This guardian deity of Akala is guilelessly cruel. The fragrant aroma of flowers is the source of its energy.

name: tapu-bulu
flavorText: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The guardian deity of Ula'ula is a lazy Pokemon. It commands plants to immobilize its foes and then deals them a savage blow with its horns.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It makes ringing sounds with its tail to let others know where it is, avoiding unneeded conflicts. This guardian deity of Ula'ula controls plants.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

pokedexEntries.GO: It pulls large trees up by the roots and swings them around. It causes vegetation to grow, and then it absorbs energy from the growth.

name: tapu-fini
flavorText: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

pokedexEntries.Sun: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The guardian deity of Poni, it can control water. People say it can create pure water that will wash away any uncleanness.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.
pokedexEntries.GO: The dense fog it creates brings the downfall and destruction of its confused enemies. Ocean currents are the source of its energy.

name: cosmog
flavorText: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
pokedexEntries.Moon: In ages past, it was called the child of the stars. It's said to be a Pokemon from another world, but no specific details are known.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Whether or not it's a Pokemon from this world is a mystery. When it's in a jam, it warps away to a safe place to hide.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Cosmog is very curious but not very cautious, often placing itself in danger. If things start to look dicey, it teleports away.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its body is gaseous and frail. It slowly grows as it collects dust from the atmosphere.

name: cosmoem
flavorText: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
pokedexEntries.Moon: There's something accumulating around the black core within its hard shell. People think this Pokemon may come from another world.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: As it absorbs light, Cosmoem continues to grow. Its golden shell is surprisingly solid.
pokedexEntries.Sword: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokemon's growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It sucks in dust from the air at an astounding rate, frantically building up energy within its core as preparation for evolution.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

pokedexEntries.GO: Motionless as if dead, its body is faintly warm to the touch. In the distant past, it was called the cocoon of the stars.

name: solgaleo
flavorText: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon is said to be a male evolution of Cosmog. At the activation of its third eye, it departs for another world.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: In writings from the distant past, it's called by the name "the beast that devours the sun."
pokedexEntries.Sword: When light radiates from its body, this Pokemon could almost appear to be the sun. It will dispel any darkness and light up the world.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

pokedexEntries.GO: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.

name: lunala
flavorText: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Said to live in another world, this Pokemon devours light, drawing the moonless dark veil of night over the brightness of day.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It sometimes summons unknown powers and life-forms here to this world from holes that lead to other worlds.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokemon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It steals the light from its surroundings and then becomes the full moon, showering its own light across the night sky.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

pokedexEntries.GO: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.

name: nihilego
flavorText: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.

pokedexEntries.Sun: One of several mysterious Ultra Beasts. People on the street report observing those infested by it suddenly becoming violent.
pokedexEntries.Moon: One of the Ultra Beasts. It's unclear whether or not this Pokemon is sentient, but sometimes it can be observed behaving like a young girl.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: A life-form from another world, it was dubbed a ub and is thought to produce a strong neurotoxin.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It appeared in this world from an Ultra Wormhole. Nihilego appears to be a parasite that lives by feeding on people and Pokemon.

flavorText: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This Ultra Beast appeared from another world. It shows off its body, but whether that display is a boast or a threat remains unclear.
pokedexEntries.Moon: A mysterious life-form called an Ultra Beast. Witnesses saw it pulverize a dump truck with a single punch.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Buzzwole goes around showing off its abnormally swollen muscles. It is one kind of Ultra Beast.

flavorText: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.

pokedexEntries.Sun: One of the dangerous Ultra Beasts, it has been spotted running across the land at terrific speeds.
pokedexEntries.Moon: One of the Ultra Beasts. It refuses to touch anything, perhaps because it senses some uncleanness in this world.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: A life-form that lives in another world, its body is thin and supple, but it also possesses great power.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: xurkitree
flavorText: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.

pokedexEntries.Sun: One of the mysterious life-forms known as Ultra Beasts. Astonishing electric shocks emanate from its entire body, according to witnesses.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. It raided a power plant, so people think it energizes itself with electricity.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: They've been dubbed Ultra Beasts. Some of them stand unmoving, like trees, with their arms and legs stuck into the ground.

flavorText: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It appeared from the Ultra Wormhole. Witnesses observed it flying across the sky at high speed.
pokedexEntries.Moon: One kind of Ultra Beast. Witnesses have seen it burn down a forest by expelling gas from its two arms.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: One of the dangerous UBs, high energy readings can be detected coming from both of its huge arms.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

flavorText: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This Ultra Beast came from the Ultra Wormhole. It seems not to attack enemies on its own, but its sharp body is a dangerous weapon in itself.
pokedexEntries.Moon: One of the Ultra Beast life-forms, it was observed cutting down a gigantic steel tower with one stroke of its blade.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: This Ultra Beast's body, which is as thin as paper, is like a sharpened sword.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

name: guzzlord
flavorText: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.
pokedexEntries.Moon: A dangerous Ultra Beast, it appears to be eating constantly, but for some reason its droppings have never been found.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: An unknown life-form called a ub. It may be constantly hungry—it is certainly always devouring something.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: It has gobbled mountains and swallowed whole buildings, according to reports. It's one of the Ultra Beasts.

name: necrozma
flavorText: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Light is apparently the source of its energy. It has an extraordinarily vicious disposition and is constantly firing off laser beams.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

pokedexEntries.GO: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

name: magearna
flavorText: This artificial Pokemon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This artificial Pokemon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: This artificial Pokemon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: This artificial Pokemon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: marshadow
flavorText: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It lurks in the shadows of others, copying their movements and powers. This Pokemon is craven and cowering.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokemon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.
pokedexEntries.Sword: By slipping into the shadow of a martial arts master and copying their movements, this Pokemon learned the ultimate techniques.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon can conceal itself in any shadow, so it went undiscovered for a long time.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

pokedexEntries.GO: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.

name: poipole
flavorText: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: An Ultra Beast that lives in a different world, it cackles wildly as it sprays its opponents with poison from the needles on its head.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.

flavorText: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: One kind of Ultra Beast, it fires a glowing, venomous liquid from its needles. This liquid is also immensely adhesive.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It stores hundreds of liters of poisonous liquid inside its body. It is one of the organisms known as UBs.

flavorText: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When stone walls started moving and attacking, the brute's true identity was this mysterious life-form, which brings to mind an Ultra Beast.

name: blacephalon
flavorText: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: A ub that appeared from an Ultra Wormhole, it causes explosions, then takes advantage of opponents' surprise to rob them of their vitality.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

name: zeraora
flavorText: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Electricity sparks from the pads on its limbs. Wherever Zeraora runs, lightning flashes and thunder echoes.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.

name: meltan
flavorText: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

pokedexEntries.GO: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.

name: melmetal
flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
pokedexEntries.Sword: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Scarlet). National Pokédex entry: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon does not naturally inhabit the Paldea region (Pokémon Violet). National Pokédex entry: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
pokedexEntries.GO: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: grookey
flavorText: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It attacks with rapid beats of its stick. As it strikes with amazing speed, it gets more and more pumped.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The stick Grookey holds has grown harder and more flexible after soaking in the energy that emanates from inside Grookey's body.
pokedexEntries.Violet: As Grookey strikes everything in sight with its stick, it has more and more fun, and its rhythm becomes livelier.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.

name: thwackey
flavorText: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

pokedexEntries.Sword: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When it's drumming out rapid beats in battle, it gets so caught up in the rhythm that it won't even notice that it's already knocked out its opponent.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It skillfully uses its two sticks not only for drumming out rapid beats but also for pummeling opponents during battle.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It becomes intensely focused while it drums out vigorous beats-so much so that sometimes it won't listen to its Trainer's commands.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
pokedexEntries.GO: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

name: rillaboom
flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

pokedexEntries.Sword: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Though it has a calm disposition, it won't tolerate those who drum up discord. It strictly disciplines offenders until they learn their lesson.
pokedexEntries.Violet: When one Rillaboom challenges another who leads a troop, a drumming battle commences. The victor becomes the troop's new boss.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
pokedexEntries.GO: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: scorbunny
flavorText: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokemon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

pokedexEntries.Sword: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokemon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Once its body has heated up, Scorbunny can use the full extent of its power. That's why it does warm-up exercises.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Fire energy gathers in the pads of its feet, raising their temperature. Once hot, Scorbunny's footpads can deal heavy damage to opponents.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokemon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.
pokedexEntries.GO: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokemon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.

name: raboot
flavorText: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Thanks to its soft and fluffy fur, Raboot can easily heat up its fire energy and produce flames with more power.
pokedexEntries.Violet: While it prides itself on its varied kicking moves, it can also deliver powerful headbutts once its flames have heated up its forehead.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.

name: cinderace
flavorText: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Although Cinderace loses its cool easily, it will battle flawlessly for a Trainer it trusts.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Using a ball that it made out of flames, Cinderace blinds its opponents and keeps them at bay.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
pokedexEntries.GO: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

name: sobble
flavorText: When scared, this Pokemon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When scared, this Pokemon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokemon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It gets berries to eat by shooting them down with bullets of water it spurts from its mouth. Its aim is perfect.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It's a very cautious Pokémon. When it has no choice but to battle, it hides itself before attacking.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When scared, this Pokemon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
pokedexEntries.GO: When scared, this Pokemon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.

name: drizzile
flavorText: A clever combatant, this Pokemon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

pokedexEntries.Sword: A clever combatant, this Pokemon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It extends its long, slimy tongue at blinding speeds and finishes off its prey with great skill.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it defends its home by laying traps.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: A clever combatant, this Pokemon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
pokedexEntries.GO: A clever combatant, this Pokemon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.

name: inteleon
flavorText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It uses special lenses in its eyes to sense things about its opponents-like their body heat-then attacks once it identifies a weak spot.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It may present itself as being well-mannered, but deep down, it still has a lazy side. It will slack off when its Trainer isn't looking.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
pokedexEntries.GO: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: skwovet
flavorText: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokemon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokemon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It eats berries nonstop—a habit that has made it more resilient than it looks. It'll show up on farms, searching for yet more berries.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It stores berries in its cheeks. When there are no berries to be found, Skwovet will stuff pebbles into its cheeks to stave off its cravings.
pokedexEntries.Violet: No matter how much it stuffs its belly with food, it is always anxious about getting hungry again. So, it stashes berries in its cheeks and tail.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokemon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
pokedexEntries.GO: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokemon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.

name: greedent
flavorText: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokemon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokemon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Common throughout the Galar region, this Pokemon has strong teeth and can chew through the toughest of berry shells.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: If it spots a berry tree, it will immediately go to gather berries without a sideways glance-even if it's in the middle of a battle.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon makes off with heaps of fallen berries by wrapping them in its tail, which is roughly twice the length of its body.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokemon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.
pokedexEntries.GO: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokemon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.

name: rookidee
flavorText: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokemon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokemon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokemon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon is brave and reckless. The white markings around a Rookidee's eyes intimidate fainthearted Pokémon.
pokedexEntries.Violet: The females are fussier than the males. If another creature dirties a female Rookidee's wings, it'll peck the offender relentlessly in a burning rage.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokemon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
pokedexEntries.GO: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokemon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.

name: corvisquire
flavorText: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokemon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokemon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It's said that the reason behind Corvisquire's high level of intelligence is the large size of its brain relative to those of other bird Pokémon.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This intelligent Pokémon will quickly learn how to use any tool it can hold in its beak or its talons.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokemon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
pokedexEntries.GO: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokemon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.

name: corviknight
flavorText: This Pokemon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
pokedexEntries.Shield: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokemon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Corviknight can't serve as a taxi service in Paldea because the Pokémon's natural predators will attack it while it flies, endangering the customer.

flavorText: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokemon bites down and never lets go.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Its large front tooth is still growing in. When the tooth itches, this Pokémon will bite another Chewtle's horn, and the two Pokémon will tussle.
pokedexEntries.Violet: A popular game among children is to lift up sticks that Chewtle have bitten onto to see whose Chewtle can hang on the longest.

name: drednaw
flavorText: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokemon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

pokedexEntries.Sword: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokemon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Its massive, jagged teeth can crush a boulder in a single bite. This Pokémon has an extremely vicious disposition.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Drednaw lurks along the shoreline. When prey come to drink water, Drednaw stretches its neck out and chomps down on them.

flavorText: This Pokemon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This gluttonous Pokemon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

name: rolycoly
flavorText: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokemon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokemon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: On sunny days, Rolycoly will come out onto grassy plains and roll around. Then it will eat the grass that gets tangled in its wheel-like leg.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon's body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokemon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
pokedexEntries.GO: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokemon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.

name: carkol
flavorText: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokemon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokemon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
pokedexEntries.Shield: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The temperature inside its body increases when it experiences strong emotions. It rolls around frantically while spewing flames.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol's back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokemon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
pokedexEntries.GO: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokemon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.

name: coalossal
flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.Shield: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from its smoldering back.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It's gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.GO: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: applin
flavorText: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokemon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokemon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.
pokedexEntries.Shield: As soon as it's born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It grows by eating the flesh of an apple. Applin uses its own body fluid to strengthen the apple's skin and prevent it from rotting.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokemon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.
pokedexEntries.GO: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokemon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.

name: flapple
flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It flutters around while seeking an opening in the opponent's guard, then attacks by spitting acidic liquid strong enough to melt metal.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It uses its own body fluid to repair its apple. Strong Flapple that have won many battles have apples that are clay colored all over.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
pokedexEntries.GO: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: appletun
flavorText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokemon it preys on.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokemon it preys on.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It feeds mainly on sweet apples. It will also eat small bug Pokémon that are attracted by its sweet nectar.
pokedexEntries.Violet: When some Lechonk come along to lick the sweet nectar on Appletun's back, Appletun will spew sticky nectar at them to drive them away.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokemon it preys on.
pokedexEntries.GO: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokemon it preys on.

name: silicobra
flavorText: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

pokedexEntries.Sword: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Silicobra's neck pouch, which can inflate and deflate like a balloon, gets more elastic each time Silicobra sheds its skin.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Silicobra's large nostrils are specialized for spraying sand, so this Pokémon is not very good at telling apart different smells.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.
pokedexEntries.GO: As it digs, it swallows sand and stores it in its neck pouch. The pouch can hold more than 17 pounds of sand.

name: sandaconda
flavorText: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It will expand its body as much as it can and then contract itself, blasting out sand with enough force to wash away a dump truck.
pokedexEntries.Violet: The sand it spews contains sharp, pointy gravel, which is actually just sand that Sandaconda's saliva has hardened into irregular shapes.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: cramorant
flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This hungry Pokemon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokemon other than its preferred prey.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They're at their most formidable when they're struggling to swallow overly large prey.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain. It focuses on battling instead.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
pokedexEntries.GO: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: arrokuda
flavorText: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokemon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

pokedexEntries.Sword: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokemon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.
pokedexEntries.Shield: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Arrokuda can swim quickly only in a straight line. The ones that become sluggish from overeating are the first to be targeted by flocks of Wattrel.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It takes down prey by charging into them with its hard, pointed jaw. But Arrokuda's eyesight is poor, so this tactic has a low success rate.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokemon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.
pokedexEntries.GO: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokemon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.

name: barraskewda
flavorText: This Pokemon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It spins its tail fins to leap from the water, then viciously bites down on Wingull flying close to the water's surface.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It swims at speeds of over 100 knots and battles fiercely with pods of Finizen over prey.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: This Pokemon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
pokedexEntries.GO: This Pokemon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.

name: toxel
flavorText: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokemon, a tingling sensation follows.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokemon, a tingling sensation follows.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokemon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
