pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Because the emotions of others constantly flow into its head, this Pokémon prefers environments where no other creatures live.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It senses the feelings of other living creatures. Be careful not to expose it to strong emotions for too long, or it will end up exhausted.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.

pokedexEntries.Sword: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokemon, it will silence you violently.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: To this Pokémon, strong emotions apparently feel like incredibly loud noises-even if the emotions are happy ones.
pokedexEntries.Violet: The moment this Pokémon finds someone who's emitting strong emotions, it will pummel them senseless with its braids to silence them.

pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Hatterene knocks out those that intrude in its home forest by blasting them with a beam, then slashing with claws enhanced by psychic power.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Beware of forests that show no signs of living creatures within. You may have wandered into Hatterene's territory.

pokedexEntries.Shield: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.

pokedexEntries.Shield: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The more sweet aromas it absorbs, the more its body swells. Milcery will deflate when its energy level drops.

pokedexEntries.Shield: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Desserts that Alcremie have decorated with their cream have a rich, sweet flavor and bring happiness to all who eat them.

pokedexEntries.Shield: The six of them work together as one Pokemon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The brass, which is the one that stands at the front and issues orders, is the strongest and smartest of the six.
pokedexEntries.Violet: The leader, known as the brass, uses its extendible horn to issue orders to the others when it's time to change formation.

pokedexEntries.Shield: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: The elemental composition of the rocks that form its body were found to match the bedrock of a land far away from this Pokémon's habitat.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon spends its life gazing at the setting sun. It strides leisurely across grassy plains on legs of rock that weigh over 400 pounds each.

name: eiscue-ice
flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: On hot days, these Pokémon press their ice cube heads together and pass the time cooling each other down.
pokedexEntries.Violet: If you lick the ice covering its face, you'll find it has a faintly salty taste. This species rode here on ocean currents from a cold, faraway land.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: indeedee-male
flavorText: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon picks up on the positive emotions of other creatures via its horns and uses those emotions to fuel itself.
pokedexEntries.Violet: This Pokémon never leaves its Trainer's side. It predicts their actions with its psychic power and takes care of their day-to-day needs.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokemon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

pokedexEntries.Sword: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokemon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Morpeko eats seeds constantly to keep its hunger at bay. If it's hungry for too long, it grows wild and brutish.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Documented in the Lumiose City urban archives (Pokémon Legends: Z-A). Dex entry: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokemon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: cufant
flavorText: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokemon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Using the pointy tip of its trunk, it carves off chunks of hard rocks to eat. It is very docile and helps people with physical labor.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Cufant can lift loads weighing five tons. In the mornings, it heads into caves with its herd, in search of the ore on which these Pokémon feed.

flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

pokedexEntries.Sword: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
pokedexEntries.Shield: These Pokemon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokémon was brought to Paldea long ago by people from a faraway land. It's so strong that it can easily pull an airplane.

name: duraludon
flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokemon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

flavorText: After being reborn as a ghost Pokemon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.

pokedexEntries.Sword: After being reborn as a ghost Pokemon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If this weak Pokemon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
pokedexEntries.Scarlet: In the evening, groups of Dreepy will fly at high speeds over the ocean and poke at Pokémon in the water for fun.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.

name: basculin-blue-striped
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.

pokedexEntries.Black: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.
pokedexEntries.White: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.White 2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.X: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.Y: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Savage, violent Pokemon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That's how violent Basculin are.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Anglers love the fight this Pokemon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.
pokedexEntries.Shield: In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it's more popular with the youth.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
pokedexEntries.GO: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.

pokedexEntries.White 2: This legendary ice Pokemon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
pokedexEntries.X: This legendary ice Pokemon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
pokedexEntries.Y: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: This legendary ice Pokemon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Dwelling within it is a power even greater than that of Reshiram or Zekrom, but the extreme cold keeps that power bound.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It appears that this Pokemon uses its powers over ice to freeze its own body in order to stabilize its cellular structure.
pokedexEntries.GO: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

name: keldeo-resolute
flavorText: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

pokedexEntries.Black: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.
pokedexEntries.White: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
pokedexEntries.White 2: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
pokedexEntries.X: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
pokedexEntries.Y: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It crosses the world, running over the surfaces of oceans and rivers. It appears at scenic waterfronts.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Cobalion, Terrakion, and Virizion taught this Pokemon how to fight. It dashes across the world, seeking more opportunities to further its training.
pokedexEntries.Shield: They say that Keldeo must survive harsh battles and fully develop the horn on its forehead before this Pokemon's true power will awaken.
pokedexEntries.GO: By blasting water from its hooves, it can glide across water. It excels at using leg moves while battling.

name: meowstic-female
flavorText: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

pokedexEntries.X: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
pokedexEntries.Y: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: The eyeball patterns on the interior of its ears emit psychic energy. It keeps the patterns tightly covered because that power is too immense.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Revealing the eyelike patterns on the insides of its ears will unleash its psychic powers. It normally keeps the patterns hidden, however.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.
pokedexEntries.GO: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.

name: aegislash-blade
flavorText: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokemon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokemon.

pokedexEntries.X: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokemon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Y: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokemon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Apparently, it can detect the innate qualities of leadership. According to legend, whoever it recognizes is destined to become king.
pokedexEntries.Sword: In this defensive stance, Aegislash uses its steel body and a force field of spectral power to reduce the damage of any attack.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokemon to build a kingdom to its liking.
pokedexEntries.GO: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokemon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokemon.

name: pumpkaboo-small
flavorText: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

pokedexEntries.X: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
pokedexEntries.Y: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It is said to carry wandering spirits to the place where they belong so they can move on.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Spirits that wander this world are placed into Pumpkaboo's body. They're then moved on to the afterlife.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokemon that see it.
pokedexEntries.GO: The pumpkin body is inhabited by a spirit trapped in this world. As the sun sets, it becomes restless and active.

name: gourgeist-small
flavorText: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

pokedexEntries.X: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
pokedexEntries.Y: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It enwraps its prey in its hairlike arms. It sings joyfully as it observes the suffering of its prey.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Eerie cries emanate from its body in the dead of night. The sounds are said to be the wails of spirits who are suffering in the afterlife.
pokedexEntries.Shield: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
pokedexEntries.GO: Singing in eerie voices, they wander town streets on the night of the new moon. Anyone who hears their song is cursed.

name: venusaur-mega
flavorText: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

pokedexEntries.X: By spreading the broad petals of its flower and catching the sun's rays, it fills its body with power.
pokedexEntries.Y: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: There is a large flower on Venusaur's back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: There is a large flower on Venusaur's back. The flower is said to take on vivid colors if it gets plenty of nutrition and sunlight. The flower's aroma soothes the emotions of people.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: The flower on its back catches the sun's rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: The flower on its back catches the sun's rays. The sunlight is then absorbed and used for energy.
pokedexEntries.Sun: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The flower on its back has grown larger due to Mega Evolution. It can release an aroma that calms battle-weary Pokémon.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: In order to support its colossal flower, its back and legs have become immensely reinforced with regenerative energy.
pokedexEntries.GO: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

name: charizard-mega-x
flavorText: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and create intense blue flames.

pokedexEntries.X: Mega Charizard X's body becomes jet black with blazing blue flames that surpass 10,000 degrees.
pokedexEntries.Y: Blue flames burn with immense heat from its mouth and the tip of its tail as dragon power awakens.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Mega Evolution has turned its body black and its flames blue. It can fly faster than a jet plane.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Mega Evolution has turned its body black and its flames blue. It can fly faster than a jet plane.
pokedexEntries.Sun: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and create intense blue flames.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Already able to fly to incredible heights, Mega Charizard X uses its wings to rocket through the air at high speeds.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The body of Charizard is dyed jet black by the overwhelming flame energy that fills its body.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It uses its wings to rocket through the air. The jet-black flames pouring from its mouth will reduce anything to cinders.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Mega Charizard X channels its internal flame energy to ignite its jet-black body with scorching blue flames.
pokedexEntries.GO: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and create intense blue flames.

name: charizard-mega-y
flavorText: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.

pokedexEntries.X: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than a jet fighter.
pokedexEntries.Y: Its fire burns even hotter than before. When it flies through the sky, it trails blindingly bright crimson light.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Charizard flies around the sky in search of powerful opponents. It breathes fire of such great heat that it melts anything. However, it never turns its fiery breath on any opponent weaker than itself.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: When this Pokemon expels a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: When this Pokemon expels a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its flame burns hotter than that of normal Charizard. It can melt even a massive glacier in a matter of seconds.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its fire burns even hotter than before. When it flies through the sky, it trails blindingly bright crimson light.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It has increased its flight ability to the extreme. Even while speeding through the sky, it can unleash devastating flames.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Mega Charizard Y reaches extreme aerodynamic speeds, raining fire down across the skies of Lumiose City.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.

name: blastoise-mega
flavorText: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs allow it to withstand the recoil from its massive blasts.

pokedexEntries.X: It crushes its foe under its heavy body to cause fainting. In a pinch, it will withdraw inside its shell.
pokedexEntries.Y: The pressurized water jets on this brutal Pokemon's shell are used for high-speed tackles.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Blastoise has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Blastoise has water spouts that protrude from its shell. The water spouts are very accurate. They can shoot bullets of water with enough accuracy to strike empty cans from a distance of over 160 feet.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Once it takes aim at its enemy, it blasts out water with even more force than a fire hose.
pokedexEntries.Sun: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs allow it to withstand the recoil from its massive blasts.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It has high-powered water cannons on both arms in addition to the large cannon on its back. It can hit targets from over six miles away.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: The cannon on its back fires water shells capable of punching clean through concrete and steel.
pokedexEntries.GO: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs allow it to withstand the recoil from its massive blasts.

name: alakazam-mega
flavorText: It sheds all power from its body to direct all its energy into pure psychokinesis. It can see a person's entire life at a glance.

pokedexEntries.X: Its brain cells multiply continually until it dies. As a result, it remembers everything.
pokedexEntries.Y: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its iq (intelligence quotient) is said to be around 5,000.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Alakazam's brain continually grows, making its head far too heavy to support with its neck. This Pokemon holds its head up using its psychokinetic power instead.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Alakazam's brain continually grows, infinitely multiplying brain cells. This amazing brain gives this Pokemon an astoundingly high iq of 5,000. It has a thorough memory of everything that has occurred in the world.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It sheds all power from its body to direct all its energy into pure psychokinesis. It can see a person's entire life at a glance.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its brain cells continue to increase in number until its death. The older the Alakazam, the larger its head.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Alakazam uses its psychic powers to make the spoons it carries. Each spoon is an original that there's only one of in the whole world.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: If it trusts someone deeply, it will let them have one of its spoons. Anything you eat with that spoon is apparently delicious.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: A Pokemon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns—that's why this Pokemon is smart.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: A Pokemon that can memorize anything. It never forgets what it learns—that's why this Pokemon is smart.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Floating in mid-air with five spoons, its boundless intellect processes a million thoughts in a single second.
pokedexEntries.GO: It sheds all power from its body to direct all its energy into pure psychokinesis. It can see a person's entire life at a glance.

name: gengar-mega
flavorText: Mega Evolution has deepened its malevolence. It can sink into another dimension to lay a trap for its prey.

pokedexEntries.X: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools the area by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.Y: Hiding in people's shadows at night, it absorbs their heat. The chill it causes makes the victims shake.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Sometimes, on a dark night, your shadow thrown by a streetlight will suddenly and startlingly overtake you. It is actually a Gengar running past you, pretending to be your shadow.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Gengar's relationships are warped. It has no interest in opponents other than those it tries to take down.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It tries to take the lives of anyone and everyone. It will even try to curse the Trainer who is its master!
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It can pass through other dimensions and appear anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck just one leg out of a wall.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Mega Evolution has deepened its malevolence. It sinks into another dimension to lay a trap for its prey.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: It can sink into another dimension, where it keeps a close eye on this world. Then it suddenly emerges from shadows.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: It can sink into another dimension, where it keeps a close eye on this world. Then it suddenly emerges from shadows.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: It can pass through other dimensions and appear anywhere. It caused a stir one time when it stuck just one leg out of a wall.
pokedexEntries.GO: Mega Evolution has deepened its malevolence. It can sink into another dimension to lay a trap for its prey.

name: kangaskhan-mega
flavorText: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

pokedexEntries.X: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets the baby out to play only when it feels safe.
pokedexEntries.Y: If it is safe, the young gets out of the belly pouch to play. The adult keeps a close eye on the youngster.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby Pokemon's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: If you come across a young Kangaskhan playing by itself, you must never disturb it or attempt to catch it. The baby Pokemon's parent is sure to be in the area, and it will become violently enraged at you.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Kangaskhan's maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The child in its pouch leaves home after roughly three years. That is the only time the mother is heard to cry wildly.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won't run from any fight to keep its young protected.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Raises its young in its belly pouch. Won't run from any fight to keep its young protected.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.
pokedexEntries.GO: The infant rarely ventures out of its mother's protective pouch until it is 3 years old.

name: pinsir-mega
flavorText: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, its wings have developed rapidly. It can fly at over 30 miles per hour.

pokedexEntries.X: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn in half. What it can't tear, it tosses far.
pokedexEntries.Y: It swings its long pincer horns wildly to attack. During cold periods, it hides deep in forests.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Pinsir is astoundingly strong. It can grip a foe weighing twice its weight in its horns and easily lift it. This Pokemon's movements turn sluggish in cold places.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Pinsir has a pair of massive horns. Protruding from the surface of these horns are thorns. These thorns are driven deeply into the foe's body when the pincer closes, making it tough for the foe to escape.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, its wings have developed rapidly. It can fly at over 30 miles per hour.
pokedexEntries.Moon: One solid blow from its horns is enough to split apart a large tree. Its greatest rival in Alola is Vikavolt.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It gets into territorial disputes with Vikavolt. For some reason, it apparently gets along well with Heracross in Alola.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can't move if it's cold out, so it lives in warm places.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Grips its prey in its pincers and squeezes hard! It can't move if it's cold out, so it lives in warm places.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: It grips enemies with giant horns and flies high into the air before slamming them into the earth.
pokedexEntries.GO: Bathed in the energy of Mega Evolution, its wings have developed rapidly. It can fly at over 30 miles per hour.

name: gyarados-mega
flavorText: Mega Evolution places a great strain on its body. The stress causes its anger to boil over into relentless destruction.

pokedexEntries.X: In ancient literature, there is a record of a Gyarados that razed a village when violence flared.
pokedexEntries.Y: Rarely seen in the wild. Huge and vicious, it is capable of destroying entire cities in a rage.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: When Magikarp evolves into Gyarados, its brain cells undergo a structural transformation. It is said that this transformation is to blame for this Pokemon's wildly violent nature.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Once Gyarados goes on a rampage, its ferociously violent blood doesn't calm until it has burned everything down. There are records of this Pokemon's rampages lasting a whole month.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Mega Evolution places a great strain on its body. The stress causes its anger to boil over into relentless destruction.
pokedexEntries.Moon: There are people who swear that any place Gyarados appears is fated for destruction.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It fires hyper beams in all directions, burning the surrounding area to ash. There are some regions where it's called "the deity of destruction."
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The energy from evolution stimulated its brain cells strongly, causing it to become very ferocious.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Brutally vicious and enormously destructive. Known for totally destroying cities in ancient times.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: I suspect this Pokemon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: It jets through the water at Mach speeds, blasting foes with immense jets of pressurized water.
pokedexEntries.GO: Mega Evolution places a great strain on its body. The stress causes its anger to boil over into relentless destruction.

name: aerodactyl-mega
flavorText: When it Mega Evolves, parts of its body turn to stone. Some claim this is Aerodactyl's original, ancient appearance.

pokedexEntries.X: It was regenerated from a dinosaur's genetic matter that was found in amber. It flies with high-pitched cries.
pokedexEntries.Y: This vicious Pokemon is said to have flown in ancient skies while shrieking high-pitched cries.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Aerodactyl is a Pokemon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Aerodactyl is a Pokemon from the age of dinosaurs. It was regenerated from genetic material extracted from amber. It is imagined to have been the king of the skies in ancient times.
pokedexEntries.Sun: When it Mega Evolves, parts of its body turn to stone. Some claim this is Aerodactyl's original, ancient appearance.
pokedexEntries.Moon: In ancient times, it ruled the skies. A widely accepted theory is that it went extinct due to a large meteor impact.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Restored from DNA found in amber, this Pokemon exhibited ferocity that was greater than expected. Some casualties resulted.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It flew through the open skies over the ancient continent as if they were its own. When it touched ground, its walk was weak and slow.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: A savage Pokemon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: A savage Pokemon that died out in ancient times. It was resurrected using DNA taken from amber.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Its jagged stone spikes tear into enemies with primal ferocity as it rules the skies of Lumiose.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it Mega Evolves, parts of its body turn to stone. Some claim this is Aerodactyl's original, ancient appearance.

name: mewtwo-mega-x
flavorText: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat.

pokedexEntries.X: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.
pokedexEntries.Y: A Pokemon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Mewtwo is a Pokemon that was created by genetic manipulation. However, even though the scientific power of humans created this Pokemon's body, they failed to endow Mewtwo with a compassionate heart.

name: scizor-mega
flavorText: It swings its eye- patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

pokedexEntries.X: This Pokemon's pincers, which contain steel, can crush any hard object it gets ahold of into bits.
pokedexEntries.Y: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This Pokemon flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This Pokemon flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It uses its wings to adjust its body temperature. Otherwise, its metal body would become too hot and melt in the heat of battle.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Once it has identified an enemy, this Pokemon smashes it mercilessly with pincers hard as steel.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its body is like steel. Its tough, heavy pincers are more suited to smashing enemies than grabbing them.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Once it has identified something as an enemy, it will continue beating them with its steel-hard pincers until there's nothing left but scraps.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.

name: heracross-mega
flavorText: This powerful Pokemon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies then lifts and throws them.

pokedexEntries.X: This powerful Pokemon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.
pokedexEntries.Y: With its Herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Heracross charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe's grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This Pokemon even has enough power to topple a massive tree.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Heracross has sharp claws on its feet. These are planted firmly into the ground or the bark of a tree, giving the Pokemon a secure and solid footing to forcefully fling away foes with its proud horn.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: This Pokemon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: This powerful Pokemon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies then lifts and throws them.

pokedexEntries.GO: This powerful Pokemon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies then lifts and throws them.

name: houndoom-mega
flavorText: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

pokedexEntries.X: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.
pokedexEntries.Y: The flames it breathes when angry contain toxins. If they cause a burn, it will hurt forever.

pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: In a Houndoom pack, the one with its horns raked sharply toward the back serves a leadership role. These Pokemon choose their leader by fighting among themselves.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: They spew flames mixed with poison to finish off their opponents. They divvy up their prey evenly among the members of their pack.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: tyranitar-mega
flavorText: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

pokedexEntries.X: In just one of its mighty hands, it has the power to make the ground shake and mountains crumble.
pokedexEntries.Y: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. This Pokemon wanders about in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. This Pokemon wanders about in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It wanders through the mountains seeking opponents to fight. If it finds an opponent that's not worthy, Tyranitar ignores it and wanders on.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: This Pokemon is a mobile disaster, leaving mountains crumbled and houses destroyed in its wake.

pokedexEntries.Y: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.

pokedexEntries.X: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.
pokedexEntries.Y: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

flavorText: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokemon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

pokedexEntries.X: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
pokedexEntries.Y: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokemon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokemon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.

name: manectric-mega
flavorText: Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokemon creates thunderclouds.

pokedexEntries.X: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
pokedexEntries.Y: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokemon creates thunderclouds.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Manectric discharges strong electricity from its mane. The mane is used for collecting electricity in the atmosphere. This Pokemon creates thunderclouds above its head.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Manectric can be found beneath unnatural thunderclouds. People say it can run at the same speed as lightning striking.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokemon creates thunderclouds.

name: banette-mega
flavorText: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokemon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

pokedexEntries.X: A doll that became a Pokemon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.
pokedexEntries.Y: Strong feelings of hatred turned a puppet into a Pokemon. If it opens its mouth, its cursed energy escapes.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokemon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: A cursed energy permeated the stuffing of a discarded and forgotten plush doll, giving it new life as Banette. The Pokemon's energy would escape if it were to ever open its mouth.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It's a stuffed toy that was thrown away and became possessed, ever searching for the one who threw it away so it can exact its revenge.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokemon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokemon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

pokedexEntries.GO: Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokemon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

name: absol-mega
flavorText: Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokemon.

pokedexEntries.X: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.
pokedexEntries.Y: It appears when it senses an impending natural disaster. As a result, it was mistaken as a doom bringer.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Absol has the ability to foretell the coming of natural disasters. It lives in a harsh, rugged mountain environment. This Pokemon very rarely ventures down from the mountains.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Although it's said to bring disaster, in actuality, this Pokemon possesses a calm disposition and warns people of any crises that loom.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The elderly call it the disaster Pokemon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.GO: Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokemon.

name: garchomp-mega
flavorText: Its arms melted into scythe-like blades due to the immense heat of Mega Evolution. It slashes its prey to ribbons.

pokedexEntries.X: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
pokedexEntries.Y: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It flies at speeds equal to a jet fighter plane. It never allows its prey to escape.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its arms melted into scythe-like blades due to the immense heat of Mega Evolution. It slashes its prey to ribbons.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The protuberances on its head serve as sensors. It can even detect distant prey.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its fine scales don't just reduce wind resistance—their sharp edges also cause injury to any opponent who attacks it.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Soars across the heavens at blinding speed—a magnificent sight! It has a feral disposition. Utmost caution is required if one meets a Garchomp out in the wilds.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Driven by burning combat instincts, it slices through obstacles and opponents with scythe-like fury.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its arms melted into scythe-like blades due to the immense heat of Mega Evolution. It slashes its prey to ribbons.

name: lucario-mega
flavorText: Black streaks all over its body show where its auras and the energy of Mega Evolution intermingled and raced through it.

pokedexEntries.X: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
pokedexEntries.Y: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: By catching the aura emanating from others, it can read their thoughts and movements.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energy. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Black streaks all over its body show where its auras and the energy of Mega Evolution intermingled and raced through it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It concentrates on its enemies with incredible calm. It battles mercilessly, striking ruthlessly at its foes.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Bathed in explosive energy, its instincts awaken. Only a Trainer with a strong aura can calm its savage impulses.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: A most gallant-looking creature. It emits energy waves and controls them with precision, using them to sense even faraway beings. I have given the name "aura" to this power.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.
pokedexEntries.GO: Black streaks all over its body show where its auras and the energy of Mega Evolution intermingled and raced through it.

name: abomasnow-mega
flavorText: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

pokedexEntries.Y: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It lives a quiet life on mountains that are perpetually covered in snow. It hides itself by whipping up blizzards.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: A powerful Pokemon that can split huge boulders with ease. Dislikes associating with others and chooses to live quietly deep within the mountains, playing with the snow.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.
pokedexEntries.GO: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

name: floette-eternal
flavorText: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

pokedexEntries.X: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
pokedexEntries.Y: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: When the flowers of a well-tended flower bed bloom, it appears and celebrates with an elegant dance.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
pokedexEntries.GO: It flutters around fields of flowers and cares for flowers that are starting to wilt. It draws out the hidden power of flowers to battle.

name: latias-mega
flavorText: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokemon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

pokedexEntries.X: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
pokedexEntries.Y: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokemon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokemon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.

flavorText: Mega Evolution has warped its wings into a single massive crescent blade. It flies at speeds exceeding high-speed jets.

pokedexEntries.X: It becomes uncontrollable if it is enraged. It destroys everything with shredding claws and fire.
pokedexEntries.Y: It's uncontrollable if enraged. It flies around spouting flames and scorching fields and mountains.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Salamence came about as a result of a strong, long-held dream of growing wings. It is said that this powerful desire triggered a sudden mutation in this Pokemon's cells, causing it to sprout its magnificent wings.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: By evolving into Salamence, this Pokemon finally realizes its long-held dream of growing wings. To express its joy, it flies and wheels all over the sky while spouting flames from its mouth.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Mega Evolution has warped its wings into a single massive crescent blade. It flies at speeds exceeding high-speed jets.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It flies around on its wings, which have grown in at last. In its happiness, it gushes hot flames, burning up the fields it passes over.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Overjoyed at finally being able to fly, it flies all over the place and usually doesn't land until it's completely exhausted and needs to sleep.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.
pokedexEntries.Legends: Z-A: Anyone standing in its way gets cleaved in two by its razor-sharp crescent wings.
pokedexEntries.GO: Mega Evolution has warped its wings into a single massive crescent blade. It flies at speeds exceeding high-speed jets.

name: beedrill-mega
flavorText: Flies at high speed and attacks using its large venomous stingers on its forelegs and tail.

pokedexEntries.X: It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
pokedexEntries.Y: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Beedrill is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nest—this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Beedrill is extremely territorial. No one should ever approach its nest—this is for their own safety. If angered, they will attack in a furious swarm.

name: rattata-alola
flavorText: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

pokedexEntries.X: Living wherever there is food available, it ceaselessly scavenges for edibles the entire day.
pokedexEntries.Y: Its fangs are long and very sharp. They grow continuously, so it gnaws on hard things to whittle them down.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly listens by moving its ears around. It is not picky about where it lives—it will make its nest anywhere.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Rattata is cautious in the extreme. Even while it is asleep, it constantly listens by moving its ears around. It is not picky about where it lives—it will make its nest anywhere.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its incisors continue growing until its death. If its Trainer doesn't offer it a file to gnaw on, it will gnaw on door frames, table legs, and so on.
pokedexEntries.Moon: With their strong capacity for survival, they can live in dirty places without concern. Left unchecked, their numbers multiply rapidly.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokemon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: This Pokemon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.
pokedexEntries.GO: Bites anything when it attacks. Small and very quick, it is a common sight in many places.

name: raticate-alola
flavorText: It uses its whis kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

pokedexEntries.X: It whittles its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder walls.
pokedexEntries.Y: The webs on its hind legs enable it to cross rivers. It searches wide areas for food.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Raticate's sturdy fangs grow steadily. To keep them ground down, it gnaws on rocks and logs. It may even chew on the walls of houses.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its hind feet are webbed, so it's a strong swimmer. It can cross rivers and sometimes even oceans.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its disposition is far more violent than its looks would suggest. Don't let your hand get too close to its face, as it could bite your hand clean off.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
pokedexEntries.GO: It uses its whis kers to maintain its balance. It apparently slows down if they are cut off.

name: pikachu-original-cap
flavorText: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.Red: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
pokedexEntries.Blue: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.
pokedexEntries.Gold: This intelligent Pokemon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It raises its tail to check its sur roundings. The tail is sometimes struck by light ning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: When it is anger ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it's evidence that this Pokemon mistook the intensity of its charge.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: This Pokemon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: This intelligent Pokemon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
pokedexEntries.Soulsilver: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Black: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.White: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.White 2: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.X: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Y: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it's evidence that this Pokemon mistook the intensity of its charge.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: This Pokemon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
pokedexEntries.Sun: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: While sleeping, it generates electricity in the sacs in its cheeks. If it's not getting enough sleep, it will be able to use only weak electricity.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
pokedexEntries.GO: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
