pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
pokedexEntries.GO: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

name: pikachu-alola-cap
flavorText: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.X: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Y: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it's evidence that this Pokemon mistook the intensity of its charge.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: This Pokemon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
pokedexEntries.Sun: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: While sleeping, it generates electricity in the sacs in its cheeks. If it's not getting enough sleep, it will be able to use only weak electricity.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
pokedexEntries.GO: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

name: raichu-alola
flavorText: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.
pokedexEntries.X: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
pokedexEntries.Y: It can loose 100,000-volt bursts of electricity, instantly downing foes several times its size.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: If the electrical sacs become excessively charged, Raichu plants its tail in the ground and discharges. Scorched patches of ground will be found near this Pokemon's nest.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: This Pokemon exudes a weak electrical charge from all over its body that makes it take on a slight glow in darkness. Raichu plants its tail in the ground to discharge electricity.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It becomes aggressive when it has electricity stored up. At such times, even its Trainer has to take care to avoid being attacked.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Because so many Trainers like the way Pikachu looks, you don't see this Pokemon very often.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: When electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes feisty. It also glows in the dark.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high voltage power.

name: sandshrew-alola
flavorText: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

pokedexEntries.X: It burrows and lives underground. If threatened, it curls itself up into a ball for protection.
pokedexEntries.Y: Disliking water, it lives in deep burrows in arid areas. It can roll itself instantly into a ball.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Sandshrew's body is configured to absorb water without waste, enabling it to survive in an arid desert. This Pokemon curls up to protect itself from its enemies.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Sandshrew has a very dry hide that is extremely tough. The Pokemon can roll into a ball that repels any attack. At night, it burrows into the desert sand to sleep.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It can roll its body into a ball. It moves through the desert by rolling at high speeds.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It usually makes its home in deserts and arid zones, where rain does not fall. It digs holes to catch Bug-type Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Its body is dry. When it gets cold at night, its hide is said to become coated with a fine dew.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It loves to bathe in the grit of dry, sandy areas. By sand bathing, the Pokemon rids itself of dirt and moisture clinging to its body.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
pokedexEntries.GO: Burrows deep underground in arid locations far from water. It only emerges to hunt for food.

name: sandslash-alola
flavorText: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

pokedexEntries.X: If it digs at an incredible pace, it may snap off its spikes and claws. They grow back in a day.
pokedexEntries.Y: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Sandslash's body is covered by tough spikes, which are hardened sections of its hide. Once a year, the old spikes fall out, to be replaced with new spikes that grow out from beneath the old ones.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Sandslash can roll up its body as if it were a ball covered with large spikes. In battle, this Pokemon will try to make the foe flinch by jabbing it with its spines. It then leaps at the stunned foe to tear wildly with its sharp claws.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Although they are sharp, its claws and spikes often break off. They grow back the next day, so it is not bothered by the temporary loss.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It uses its claws to climb trees and then curls its body into a spiny ball, ready to drop onto any prey that appears.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Thanks to its thick claws, it's good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: It is skilled at slashing enemies with its claws. If broken, they start to grow back in a day.
pokedexEntries.Sword: The drier the area Sandslash lives in, the harder and smoother the Pokemon's spikes will feel when touched.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
pokedexEntries.GO: Curls up into a spiny ball when threatened. It can roll while curled up to attack or escape.

name: vulpix-alola
flavorText: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

pokedexEntries.X: When it is born, it has just one snow-white tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.
pokedexEntries.Y: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: At the time of its birth, Vulpix has one white tail. The tail separates into six if this Pokemon receives plenty of love from its Trainer. The six tails become magnificently curled.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Inside Vulpix's body burns a flame that never goes out. During the daytime, when the temperatures rise, this Pokemon releases flames from its mouth to prevent its body from growing too hot.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its beautiful fur and tails have made it very popular. As it grows, its tails split to form more tails.
pokedexEntries.Moon: From its mouth spew flames that seem to resemble the spirits of the deceased. Some people mistakenly think this fire is a ghost.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its beautiful tails have made it very popular. However, if it's not brushed diligently, it will be a mass of tangles before you know it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It manipulates balls of fire to catch its prey. If you raise one from when it's young, it will grow close to you like a puppy Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Both its fur and its tails are beautiful. As it grows, the tails split and form more tails.
pokedexEntries.Sword: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
pokedexEntries.Shield: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokemon has but one white tail. As the Pokemon matures, this single tail splits into six.
pokedexEntries.GO: At the time of birth, it has just one tail. The tail splits from its tip as it grows older.

name: ninetales-alola
flavorText: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

pokedexEntries.X: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
pokedexEntries.Y: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Ninetales casts a sinister light from its bright red eyes to gain total control over its foe's mind. This Pokemon is said to live for a thousand years.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Legend has it that Ninetales came into being when nine wizards possessing sacred powers merged into one. This Pokemon is highly intelligent—it can understand human speech.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Legend has it that this mystical Pokemon was formed when nine saints coalesced into one.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Said to live for a thousand years, this Pokemon uses its supernatural abilities to manipulate fire. It can burn its prey to a crisp as it pleases.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It is vindictive and relentless by nature. Those who cross it even once will be cursed for a thousand years, along with their descendants.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The flickering flames it spews from its mouth leave its opponents hypnotized. Then, this extremely intelligent Pokemon attacks.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: According to an enduring legend, nine noble saints were united and reincarnated as this Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: According to an enduring legend, nine noble saints were united and reincarnated as this Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.
pokedexEntries.GO: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1000-year curse.

name: diglett-alola
flavorText: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

pokedexEntries.X: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
pokedexEntries.Y: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple— wherever this Pokemon burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Diglett are raised in most farms. The reason is simple— wherever this Pokemon burrows, the soil is left perfectly tilled for planting crops. This soil is made ideal for growing delicious vegetables.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It chews on plant roots underground. Farmers whose vegetables are vulnerable find it can be quite a pest.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Many farmers cherish and nurture Diglett because its droppings enrich the soil it lives in.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Around their crops, farmers plant the kind of tree that Diglett like to eat as a way of getting Diglett to plow the fields for them.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: It prefers dark places. It spends most of its time underground, though it may pop up in caves.
pokedexEntries.Sword: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
pokedexEntries.GO: Lives about one yard underground where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears above ground.

name: dugtrio-alola
flavorText: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

pokedexEntries.X: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
pokedexEntries.Y: Extremely powerful, they can dig through even the hardest ground to a depth of over 60 miles.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Dugtrio are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Dugtrio are actually triplets that emerged from one body. As a result, each triplet thinks exactly like the other two triplets. They work cooperatively to burrow endlessly.
pokedexEntries.Sun: This set of triplets moves cooperatively. It's the power of teamwork that enables this Pokemon to dig to a depth of 60 miles.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Despite the closeness between this Pokemon and farmers and other people, no one has ever seen the parts of it concealed underground.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Dugtrio's heads are sleek and smooth and incredibly hard. It can dig through any soil with its headbutts.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It's reported that this triggers an earthquake.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: A team of triplets that can burrow to a depth of 60 miles. It's reported that this triggers an earthquake.
pokedexEntries.Sword: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
pokedexEntries.Shield: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
pokedexEntries.GO: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.

name: meowth-alola
flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

pokedexEntries.Shield: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.
pokedexEntries.X: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.
pokedexEntries.Y: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Meowth withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokemon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Meowth withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokemon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It loves shiny things. It often fights with Murkrow over prey they're both trying to catch.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It loves coins, so if you give it one, you can make friends with Meowth easily. But it's fickle, so you can't count on that friendship lasting.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop itself from picking them up.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop itself from picking them up.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
pokedexEntries.GO: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: persian-alola
flavorText: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

pokedexEntries.X: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
pokedexEntries.Y: Its lithe muscles allow it to walk without making a sound. It attacks in an instant.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Persian has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the Pokemon's surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Persian has six bold whiskers that give it a look of toughness. The whiskers sense air movements to determine what is in the Pokemon's surrounding vicinity. It becomes docile if grabbed by the whiskers.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It has a high opinion of itself, although not to the same extent as the Alolan Persian. It's quite difficult to make friends with this Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: This Pokemon is popular with rich people. It's also targeted by hunters who are after the jewel in its forehead.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: The gem in its forehead glows on its own! It walks with all the grace and elegance of a proud queen.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Getting this prideful Pokemon to warm up to you takes a lot of effort, and it will claw at you the moment it gets annoyed.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
pokedexEntries.GO: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.

name: geodude-alola
flavorText: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

pokedexEntries.X: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.
pokedexEntries.Y: It is impossible to distinguish from rocks. It slams against others in contests of hardness.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: The longer a Geodude lives, the more its edges are chipped and worn away, making it more rounded in appearance. However, this Pokemon's heart will remain hard, craggy, and rough always.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: When Geodude sleeps deeply, it buries itself halfway into the ground. It will not awaken even if hikers step on it unwittingly. In the morning, this Pokemon rolls downhill in search of food.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its round body makes it easy to pick up, but it is hard and heavy. It's dangerous to play with them as if they were snowballs.
pokedexEntries.Moon: There are plenty of them to be found along any road. A scholar with too much free time once counted a hundred of them along a single route.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Commonly found near mountain trails and the like. If you step on one by accident, it gets angry.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.
pokedexEntries.GO: Found in fields and mountains. Mistaking them for boulders, people often step or trip on them.

name: graveler-alola
flavorText: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

pokedexEntries.X: With a free and uncaring nature, it doesn't mind if pieces break off while it rolls down mountains.
pokedexEntries.Y: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Graveler grows by feeding on rocks. Apparently, it prefers to eat rocks that are covered in moss. This Pokemon eats its way through a ton of rocks on a daily basis.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Rocks are Graveler's favorite food. This Pokemon will climb a mountain from the base to the summit, crunchingly feasting on rocks all the while. Upon reaching the peak, it rolls back down to the bottom.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Mossy rocks are its favorite food. It can devour a ton a day while crunching loudly.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This slow-footed Pokemon moves by curling up and rolling instead of walking. With enough momentum, its speed can exceed 60 mph.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Often seen rolling down mountain trails. Obstacles are just things to roll straight over, not avoid.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.
pokedexEntries.GO: Rolls down slopes to move. It rolls over any obstacle without slowing or changing its direction.

name: golem-alola
flavorText: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

pokedexEntries.X: It tumbles down mountains, leaving grooves from peak to base. Stay clear of these grooves.
pokedexEntries.Y: Even dynamite can't harm its hard, boulder-like body. It sheds its hide just once a year.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Golem live up on mountains. If there is a large earthquake, these Pokemon will come rolling down off the mountains en masse to the foothills below.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Golem is known for rolling down from mountains. To prevent them from rolling into the homes of people downhill, grooves have been dug into the sides of mountains to serve as guideways for diverting this Pokemon's course.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its body can survive dynamite blasts without a single scratch, but it hates rain and humidity.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Once a year, this Pokemon molts, and its shed shell returns to the soil. This process creates enriched soil, so farmers collect the shells.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Once it sheds its skin, its body turns tender and whitish. Its hide hardens when it's exposed to air.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its boulder-like body is extremely hard. It can easily withstand dynamite blasts without damage.

name: grimer-alola
flavorText: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

pokedexEntries.X: Sludge exposed to X-rays from the moon transformed into Grimer. It loves feeding on filthy things.
pokedexEntries.Y: Appears in filthy areas. It thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Grimer's sludgy and rubbery body can be forced through any opening, however small it may be. This Pokemon enters sewer pipes to drink filthy wastewater.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Grimer emerged from the sludge that settled on a polluted seabed. This Pokemon loves anything filthy. It constantly leaks a horribly germ-infested fluid from all over its body.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Its main source of food is the slimy industrial waste of factories. This Pokemon's numbers have been decreasing in recent years.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It was born from sludge transformed by exposure to X-rays from the moon. When its internal load of germs decreases, it dies.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It was born from sludge on the ocean floor. In a sterile environment, the germs within its body can't multiply, and it dies.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won't grow in its path.
pokedexEntries.GO: Appears in filthy areas. Thrives by sucking up polluted sludge that is pumped out of factories.

name: muk-alola
flavorText: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

pokedexEntries.X: They love to gather in smelly areas where sludge accumulates, making the stench around them worse.
pokedexEntries.Y: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid instantly kills plants and trees on contact.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: From Muk's body seeps a foul fluid that gives off a nose-bendingly horrible stench. Just one drop of this Pokemon's body fluid can turn a pool stagnant and rancid.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: This Pokemon's favorite food is anything that is repugnantly filthy. In dirty towns where people think nothing of throwing away litter on the streets, Muk are certain to gather.
pokedexEntries.Sun: The stench it gives off will make your nose scrunch up. Still, there are Muk fans who think that's a good thing.
pokedexEntries.Moon: After recent environmental improvements, this Pokemon is now hardly seen at all. People speculate that it may go extinct at some point.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Their food sources have decreased, and their numbers have declined sharply. Sludge ponds are being built to prevent their extinction.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
pokedexEntries.GO: Thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.

name: exeggutor-alola
flavorText: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

pokedexEntries.X: Its three heads think independently. However, they are friendly and never appear to squabble.
pokedexEntries.Y: It is called "The Walking Jungle." If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Exeggutor originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form Exeggcute.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Exeggutor originally came from the tropics. Its heads steadily grow larger from exposure to strong sunlight. It is said that when the heads fall off, they group together to form Exeggcute.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Each of its heads has its own will. They use telepathy to discuss their plans before coming to a joint decision.
pokedexEntries.Moon: When the time comes, one of its three heads falls off. Before long, the fallen head grows into an Exeggcute.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the three heads thinks about whatever it likes.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Its cries are very noisy. This is because each of the three heads thinks about whatever it likes.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokemon sluggish.
pokedexEntries.GO: Legend has it that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.

name: marowak-alola
flavorText: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to ko targets.

pokedexEntries.X: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
pokedexEntries.Y: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to ko targets.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokemon's tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokemon's tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution, its temperament becomes violent, and it begins to wield bones as weapons.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon is out for vengeance on its natural enemy, Mandibuzz. It throws bones like boomerangs to try to take it down.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Small and weak, this Pokemon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Small and weak, this Pokemon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When this Pokemon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
pokedexEntries.GO: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to ko targets.

flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

pokedexEntries.X: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
pokedexEntries.Y: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

flavorText: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

pokedexEntries.X: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
pokedexEntries.Y: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.
pokedexEntries.Sun: This is Zygarde's form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: This is Zygarde's form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
pokedexEntries.GO: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: gumshoos-totem
flavorText: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

pokedexEntries.Sun: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It adores having Rattata and Raticate for dinner, but as it's diurnal, it never encounters them. This Pokemon boasts incredible patience.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokemon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Patient by nature, this Pokemon loses control of itself and pounces when it spots its favorite meal—Rattata!
pokedexEntries.GO: When it finds a trace of its prey, it patiently stakes out the location...but it's always snoozing by nightfall.

name: vikavolt-totem
flavorText: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It produces electricity via an electrical organ in its abdomen. It overwhelms bird Pokemon with shocking beams of electrical energy.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Vikavolt flusters opponents with acrobatic flying maneuvers. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electric beam attack.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.
pokedexEntries.GO: It zips around, on sharp lookout for an opening. It concentrates electrical energy within its large jaws and uses it to zap its enemies.

name: oricorio-pom-pom
flavorText: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Oricorio has sipped red nectar. Its passionate dance moves cause its enemies to combust in both body and mind.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It wins the hearts of its enemies with its passionate dancing and then uses the opening it creates to burn them up with blazing flames.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokemon becomes fiercely angry.
pokedexEntries.GO: It beats its wings together to create fire. As it moves in the steps of its beautiful dance, it bathes opponents in intense flames.

name: lycanroc-midnight
flavorText: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
pokedexEntries.Moon: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.
pokedexEntries.Shield: With swift movements, this Pokemon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: wishiwashi-school
flavorText: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

pokedexEntries.Sun: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's awfully weak and notably tasty, so everyone is always out to get it. As it happens, anyone trying to bully it receives a painful lesson.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: They're weak, so they move in schools. However, they can also often be seen all alone, having strayed from the school.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When it's in a jam, its shining eyes attract others of its kind. The light from its eyes is visible almost 25 miles away.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it's in trouble, its eyes moisten and begin to shine. The shining light attracts its comrades, and they stand together against their enemies.

name: lurantis-totem
flavorText: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It fires beams from its sickle-shaped petals. These beams are powerful enough to cleave through thick metal plates.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokemon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon resembles a beautiful flower. A properly raised Lurantis will have gorgeous, brilliant colors.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The petals on this Pokemon's arms are thin and super sharp, and they can fire laser beams if Lurantis gathers light first.
pokedexEntries.GO: It requires a lot of effort to maintain Lurantis's vivid coloring, but some collectors enjoy this work and treat it as their hobby.

name: salazzle-totem
flavorText: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

pokedexEntries.Sun: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Filled with pheromones, its poisonous gas can be diluted to use in the production of luscious perfumes.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It punishes Salandit that couldn't bring it food with a fierce slap of its flame-spewing palm.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.
pokedexEntries.GO: For some reason, only females have been found. It creates a reverse harem of male Salandit that it lives with.

name: minior-orange-meteor
flavorText: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Strong impacts can knock it out of its shell. This Pokemon was born from mutated nanoparticles.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It lives in the ozone layer, where it becomes food for stronger Pokemon. When it tries to run away, it falls to the ground.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although its outer shell is uncommonly durable, the shock of falling to the ground smashes the shell to smithereens.
pokedexEntries.GO: Originally making its home in the ozone layer, it hurtles to the ground when the shell enclosing its body grows too heavy.

name: mimikyu-busted
flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
pokedexEntries.Moon: A lonely Pokemon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokemon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokemon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.
pokedexEntries.Shield: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu's old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

flavorText: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.
pokedexEntries.Moon: A lonely Pokemon, it conceals its terrifying appearance beneath an old rag so it can get closer to people and other Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokemon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: A gust of wind revealed what hides under this Pokemon's rag to a passing Trainer, who went home and died painfully that very night.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.
pokedexEntries.Shield: There was a scientist who peeked under Mimikyu's old rag in the name of research. The scientist died of a mysterious disease.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by terror and died from the shock.

name: kommo-o-totem
flavorText: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

pokedexEntries.Sun: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its rigid scales function as offense and defense. In the past, its scales were processed and used to make weapons and other commodities.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It battles valiantly with its fists, which are armored in steel scales. Kommo-o specializes in uppercuts.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It clatters its tail scales to unnerve opponents. This Pokemon will battle only those who stand steadfast in the face of this display.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Certain ruins have paintings of ancient warriors wearing armor made of Kommo-o scales.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it spots enemies, it threatens them by jingling the scales on its tail. Weak opponents will crack and flee in panic.

name: magearna-original
flavorText: This artificial Pokemon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

pokedexEntries.Sun: This artificial Pokemon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Its mechanized body is merely a vessel. Its true self is its Soul-Heart, an artificial soul.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It synchronizes its consciousness with others to understand their feelings. This faculty makes it useful for taking care of people.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
pokedexEntries.GO: This artificial Pokemon, constructed more than 500 years ago, can understand human speech but cannot itself speak.

name: pikachu-partner-cap
flavorText: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.Red: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
pokedexEntries.Blue: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.
pokedexEntries.Gold: This intelligent Pokemon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It raises its tail to check its sur roundings. The tail is sometimes struck by light ning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: When it is anger ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
pokedexEntries.GO: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.Red: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to ko targets.
pokedexEntries.Blue: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to ko targets.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Small and weak, this Pokemon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
pokedexEntries.Gold: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out mes sages to others.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It collects bones from an unknown place. A Marowak graveyard exists somewhere in the world, rumors say.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: Somewhere in the world is a ceme tery just for Marowak. It gets its bones from those graves.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokemon's tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokemon's tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: A Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has grown tough by overcoming the grief of losing its mother. Its tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It is small and was originally very weak. Its temperament turned ferocious when it began using bones.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to ko targets.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: From its birth, this savage Pokemon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: From its birth, this savage Pokemon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: From its birth, this savage Pokemon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: It has been seen pounding boulders with the bone it carries in order to tap out messages to others.
pokedexEntries.Soulsilver: It collects bones from an unknown place. Some whisper that a Marowak graveyard exists somewhere in the world.
pokedexEntries.Black: From its birth, this savage Pokemon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.
pokedexEntries.White: From its birth, this savage Pokemon constantly holds bones. It is skilled in using them as weapons.

pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Marowak is the evolved form of a Cubone that has overcome its sadness at the loss of its mother and grown tough. This Pokemon's tempered and hardened spirit is not easily broken.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Originally, it was weak and timid. After evolution, its temperament becomes violent, and it begins to wield bones as weapons.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon is out for vengeance on its natural enemy, Mandibuzz. It throws bones like boomerangs to try to take it down.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Small and weak, this Pokemon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Small and weak, this Pokemon is adept with its bone club. It has grown more vicious over the ages.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon overcame its sorrow to evolve a sturdy new body. Marowak faces its opponents bravely, using a bone as a weapon.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When this Pokemon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
pokedexEntries.GO: The bone it holds is its key weapon. It throws the bone skillfully like a boomerang to ko targets.

name: ribombee-totem
flavorText: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Some of Ribombee's pollen puffs are highly nutritious. They are sometimes sold as supplements.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Rain makes pollen damp, so Ribombee hates rain. When it sees ominous clouds, it finds a hollow in a tree, where it waits stock-still.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It can predict the weather from moisture levels and wind direction. Ribombee only reveals itself when there are a few clear days in a row.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.
pokedexEntries.GO: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

name: rockruff-own-tempo
flavorText: It's considered to be a good Pokemon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It's considered to be a good Pokemon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon has lived with people since times long ago. It can sense when its Trainer is in the dumps and will stick close by its Trainer's side.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon intimidates opponents by striking the ground with the rocks on its neck. The moment an opponent flinches, Rockruff attacks.
pokedexEntries.GO: It's considered to be a good Pokemon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.

name: lycanroc-dusk
flavorText: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
pokedexEntries.Moon: When properly raised from a young age, it will become a trustworthy partner that will absolutely never betray its Trainer.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The sharp rocks in its mane can cut like knives. Lycanroc wears its prey down by degrees before finishing them off.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Lycanroc is calm and cautious. The rocks jutting from its mane are razor sharp.
pokedexEntries.Shield: With swift movements, this Pokemon gradually backs its prey into a corner. Lycanroc's fangs are always aimed toward opponents' weak spots.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

name: araquanid-totem
flavorText: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokemon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokemon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Despite what its appearance suggests, it cares for others. If it finds vulnerable, weak Pokemon, it protectively brings them into its water bubble.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It has a habit of storing things it values in its water bubble. If its Trainer doesn't watch out, Araquanid will try to put them in its bubble!
pokedexEntries.Sword: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokemon can then take its time to savor its meal.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
pokedexEntries.GO: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokemon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

name: togedemaru-totem
flavorText: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

pokedexEntries.Sun: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The long hairs on its back act as lightning rods. The bolts of lightning it attracts are stored as energy in its electric sac.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its capacity to produce electricity is somewhat limited, so it gets charged up by letting lightning strike it!
pokedexEntries.Sword: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokemon takes in electricity from other electric Pokemon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
pokedexEntries.GO: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokemon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

name: necrozma-dusk
flavorText: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Light is apparently the source of its energy. It has an extraordinarily vicious disposition and is constantly firing off laser beams.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Light is the source of its energy. If it isn't devouring light, impurities build up in it and on it, and Necrozma darkens and stops moving.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It survives by absorbing light. After a long time spent slumbering underground, impurities accumulated within it, causing its body to darken.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It needs light to survive, and it goes on a rampage seeking it out. Its laser beams will cut anything to pieces.
pokedexEntries.GO: Reminiscent of the Ultra Beasts, this life-form, apparently asleep underground, is thought to have come from another world in ancient times.
