name: eevee-starter
flavorText: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

pokedexEntries.Red: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
pokedexEntries.Blue: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: Its genetic code is unstable, so it could evolve in a variety of ways. There are only a few alive.
pokedexEntries.Gold: It has the ability to alter the com position of its body to suit its surrounding envi ronment.
pokedexEntries.Silver: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its en vironment changes.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokemon to evolve.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokemon to evolve.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: An Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to its environment. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokemon to evolve.
pokedexEntries.Firered: An extremely rare Pokemon that may evolve in a number of different ways depending on stimuli.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: A rare Pokemon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: A rare Pokemon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
pokedexEntries.Soulsilver: Its irregularly configured DNA is affected by its surroundings. It evolves if its environment changes.
pokedexEntries.Black: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
pokedexEntries.White: Because its genetic makeup is irregular, it quickly changes its form due to a variety of causes.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokemon conceals many different possible evolutions.
pokedexEntries.White 2: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokemon conceals many different possible evolutions.
pokedexEntries.X: A rare Pokemon that adapts to harsh environments by taking on different evolutionary forms.
pokedexEntries.Y: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokemon conceals many different possible evolutions.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokemon to evolve.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Eevee has an unstable genetic makeup that suddenly mutates due to the environment in which it lives. Radiation from various stones causes this Pokemon to evolve.
pokedexEntries.Sun: Possessing an unbalanced and unstable genetic makeup, it conceals many possible evolutions.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Current studies show it can evolve into an incredible eight different species of Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its genes are easily influenced by its surroundings. Even its face starts to look like that of its Trainer.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: It can evolve into a variety of forms. Eevee's genes are the key to solving the mysteries of Pokemon evolution.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: It can evolve into a variety of forms. Eevee's genes are the key to solving the mysteries of Pokemon evolution.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokemon conceals many different possible evolutions.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokemon evolution—I'm certain of it.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element STONEs.

name: pikachu-world-cap
flavorText: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

pokedexEntries.Red: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
pokedexEntries.Blue: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.
pokedexEntries.Yellow: It keeps its tail raised to monitor its surroundings. If you yank its tail, it will try to bite you.
pokedexEntries.Gold: This intelligent Pokemon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
pokedexEntries.Silver: It raises its tail to check its sur roundings. The tail is sometimes struck by light ning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Crystal: When it is anger ed, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.
pokedexEntries.Ruby: Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it's evidence that this Pokemon mistook the intensity of its charge.
pokedexEntries.Sapphire: This Pokemon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
pokedexEntries.Emerald: It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks. When it releases pent-up energy in a burst, the electric power is equal to a lightning bolt.
pokedexEntries.Firered: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
pokedexEntries.Leafgreen: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.
pokedexEntries.Diamond: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the pouches on its cheeks.
pokedexEntries.Pearl: If it looses crackling power from the electric pouches on its cheeks, it is being wary.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: This intelligent Pokemon roasts hard berries with electricity to make them tender enough to eat.
pokedexEntries.Soulsilver: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Black: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.White: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.White 2: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.
pokedexEntries.X: It raises its tail to check its surroundings. The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.
pokedexEntries.Y: It has small electric sacs on both its cheeks. If threatened, it looses electric charges from the sacs.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Whenever Pikachu comes across something new, it blasts it with a jolt of electricity. If you come across a blackened berry, it's evidence that this Pokemon mistook the intensity of its charge.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: This Pokemon has electricity-storing pouches on its cheeks. These appear to become electrically charged during the night while Pikachu sleeps. It occasionally discharges electricity when it is dozy after waking up.
pokedexEntries.Sun: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's in its nature to store electricity. It feels stressed now and then if it's unable to fully discharge the electricity.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: While sleeping, it generates electricity in the sacs in its cheeks. If it's not getting enough sleep, it will be able to use only weak electricity.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: This forest-dwelling Pokemon stores electricity in its cheeks, so you'll feel a tingly shock if you touch it.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
pokedexEntries.GO: When several of these Pokemon gather, their electricity could build and cause lightning storms.

name: meowth-galar
flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

pokedexEntries.Shield: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.
pokedexEntries.Sun: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It loves shiny things. It often fights with Murkrow over prey they're both trying to catch.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It loves coins, so if you give it one, you can make friends with Meowth easily. But it's fickle, so you can't count on that friendship lasting.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop itself from picking them up.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can't stop itself from picking them up.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
pokedexEntries.GO: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: ponyta-galar
flavorText: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Capable of jumping incredibly high. Its hooves and sturdy legs absorb the impact of a hard landing.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: These Pokemon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its hooves are 10 times harder than diamonds. It can trample anything completely flat in little time.

name: rapidash-galar
flavorText: Very competitive, this Pokemon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Just loves to run. If it sees something faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Just loves to run. If it sees something faster than itself, it will give chase at top speed.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.
pokedexEntries.GO: Very competitive, this Pokemon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

name: slowpoke-galar
flavorText: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Alolan home cooking involves drying Slowpoke tails and then simmering them into a salty stew.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Although their tails, which fall off naturally, can easily be found lying around, they're a precious ingredient for cooking.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Incredibly slow and sluggish. It is quite content to loll about without worrying about the time.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Slow-witted and oblivious, this Pokemon won't feel any pain if its tail gets eaten. It won't notice when its tail grows back, either.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When this Pokemon's tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.GO: Incredibly slow and dopey. It takes 5 seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.

name: slowbro-galar
flavorText: The Shellder that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder's poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Whenever Shellder bites down hard on its tail, it gives Slowbro a flash of inspiration...which it forgets a moment later.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Shellder, in its greed to suck out more and more sweetness from Slowbro's tail, has metamorphosed into a spiral-shaped shell.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Lives lazily by the sea. If the Shellder on its tail comes off, it becomes a Slowpoke again.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Slowpoke became Slowbro when a Shellder bit on to its tail. Sweet flavors seeping from the tail make the Shellder feel as if its life is a dream.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokemon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.
pokedexEntries.GO: The Shellder that is latched onto SLOWPOKE's tail is said to feed on the host's left over scraps.

name: farfetchd-galar
flavorText: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: They live where reedy plants grow. Farfetch'd are rarely seen, so it's thought their numbers are decreasing.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: They live where reedy plants grow. Farfetch'd are rarely seen, so it's thought their numbers are decreasing.
pokedexEntries.Sword: The stalk this Pokemon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.
pokedexEntries.Shield: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.
pokedexEntries.GO: The sprig of green onions it holds is its weapon. It is used much like a metal sword.

name: weezing-galar
flavorText: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: This Pokemon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: This Pokemon lives and grows by absorbing poison gas, dust, and germs that exist inside garbage.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It mixes gases between its two bodies. It's said that these Pokemon were seen all over the Galar region back in the day.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It can't suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.
pokedexEntries.GO: Where two kinds of poison gases meet, 2 KOFFINGs can fuse into a Weezing over many years.

name: mr-mime-galar
flavorText: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It creates invisible walls with its pantomiming. If you don't act impressed, it will attack you with a double slap!
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Always practicing its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn't.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Always practicing its pantomime act. It makes enemies believe something exists that really doesn't.
pokedexEntries.Sword: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It's known for its top-notch pantomime skills. It protects itself from all sorts of attacks by emitting auras from its fingers to create walls.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The behavior of this clown-like Pokemon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.
pokedexEntries.GO: If interrupted while it is miming, it will slap around the offender with its broad hands.

name: articuno-galar
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokemon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: A legendary bird Pokemon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: A legendary bird Pokemon. It freezes water that is contained in winter air and makes it snow.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It's said that this Pokemon's beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.
pokedexEntries.GO: A legendary bird Pokemon that is said to appear to doomed people who are lost in icy mountains.

name: zapdos-galar
flavorText: A legendary bird Pokemon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: This legendary bird Pokemon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: This legendary bird Pokemon is said to appear when the sky turns dark and lightning showers down.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokemon. It's said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.
pokedexEntries.GO: A legendary bird Pokemon that is said to appear from clouds while dropping enormous lightning bolts.

name: moltres-galar
flavorText: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: A legendary bird Pokemon. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: A legendary bird Pokemon. As it flaps its flaming wings, even the night sky will turn red.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It's one of the legendary bird Pokemon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.
pokedexEntries.Shield: There are stories of this Pokemon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.
pokedexEntries.GO: Known as the legendary bird of fire. Every flap of its wings creates a dazzling flash of flames.

name: slowking-galar
flavorText: It has incredible intellect and in tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

pokedexEntries.Sun: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon is so famed for its intellect that a proverb still persists in some regions: "When in doubt, ask Slowking."
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It's constantly coming up with new ideas that would change the world, but as soon as it hits upon a new idea, it forgets it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It's called "the sage of the sea." It engages in battles of wits with Oranguru, but the result is usually a draw.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Miraculously, this former Slowpoke's latent intelligence was drawn out when Shellder poison raced through its brain.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.
pokedexEntries.GO: It has incredible intellect and in tuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

name: corsola-galar
flavorText: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Coral branches grow from its head. They break off quite easily, but they grow back in about three days.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Pursued by Mareanie for the branches on its head, this Pokemon will sometimes snap its own branches off as a diversion while it escapes.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The pink of Corsola that live in Alola is deep and vibrant, thanks to seas filled with nutrition.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: In Alola, where their natural enemies Mareanie are plentiful, many Corsola have stubby branches on their heads.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It will regrow any branches that break off its head. People keep particularly beautiful Corsola branches as charms to promote safe childbirth.
pokedexEntries.Shield: These Pokemon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.
pokedexEntries.GO: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure for its beauty.

name: zigzagoon-galar
flavorText: Zigzagoon restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokemon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It marks its territory by rubbing its bristly fur on trees. This variety of Zigzagoon is friendlier and calmer than the kind native to Galar.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you've lost something, this Pokemon can likely find it.
pokedexEntries.GO: Zigzagoon restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokemon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.

name: linoone-galar
flavorText: Linoone always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokemon is very challenged by gently curving roads.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Its fur is strong and supple. Shaving brushes made with shed Linoone hairs are highly prized.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.
pokedexEntries.GO: Linoone always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokemon is very challenged by gently curving roads.

name: darumaka-galar
flavorText: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokemon will immediately fall asleep.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This popular symbol of good fortune will never fall over in its sleep, no matter how it's pushed or pulled.
pokedexEntries.GO: When its internal fire is burning, it cannot calm down and it runs around. When the fire diminishes, it falls asleep.

name: darmanitan-galar-standard
flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

pokedexEntries.Sword: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokemon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: darmanitan-galar-zen
flavorText: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

pokedexEntries.Sword: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokemon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon's power level rises along with the temperature of its fire, which can reach 2,500 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its internal fire burns at 2,500° F, making enough power that it can destroy a dump truck with one punch.

name: yamask-galar
flavorText: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It wanders through ruins by night, carrying a mask that's said to have been the face it had when it was still human.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokemon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.
pokedexEntries.GO: Each of them carries a mask that used to be its face when it was human. Sometimes they look at it and cry.

name: stunfisk-galar
flavorText: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokemon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.
pokedexEntries.Shield: For some reason, this Pokemon smiles slightly when it emits a strong electric current from the yellow markings on its body.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.

name: zygarde-10
flavorText: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

pokedexEntries.X: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
pokedexEntries.Y: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: It's hypothesized that it's monitoring those who destroy the ecosystem from deep in the cave where it lives.
pokedexEntries.Sun: This is Zygarde's form when it has gathered 50% of its cells. It wipes out all those who oppose it, showing not a shred of mercy.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's thought to be monitoring the ecosystem. There are rumors that even greater power lies hidden within it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: This is Zygarde's form when about half of its pieces have been assembled. It plays the role of monitoring the ecosystem.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
pokedexEntries.GO: When the Kalos region's ecosystem falls into disarray, it appears and reveals its secret power.

name: cramorant-gulping
flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This hungry Pokemon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokemon other than its preferred prey.
pokedexEntries.GO: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: cramorant-gorging
flavorText: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This hungry Pokemon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokemon other than its preferred prey.
pokedexEntries.GO: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

name: toxtricity-low-key
flavorText: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokemon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
pokedexEntries.GO: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: eiscue-noice
flavorText: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
pokedexEntries.GO: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.

name: indeedee-female
flavorText: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
pokedexEntries.GO: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.

name: morpeko-hangry
flavorText: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokemon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

pokedexEntries.Sword: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokemon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
pokedexEntries.GO: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokemon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.

name: zacian-crowned
flavorText: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokemon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokemon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon has slumbered for many years. Some say it's Zamazenta's elder sister—others say the two Pokemon are rivals.
pokedexEntries.GO: Known as a legendary hero, this Pokemon absorbs metal particles, transforming them into a weapon it uses to battle.

name: zamazenta-crowned
flavorText: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

pokedexEntries.Sword: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
pokedexEntries.GO: In times past, it worked together with a king of the people to save the Galar region. It absorbs metal that it then uses in battle.

name: eternatus-eternamax
flavorText: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

pokedexEntries.Sword: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokemon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
pokedexEntries.GO: The core on its chest absorbs energy emanating from the lands of the Galar region. This energy is what allows Eternatus to stay active.

name: urshifu-rapid-strike
flavorText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokemon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
pokedexEntries.GO: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

name: zarude-dada
flavorText: Within dense forests, this Pokemon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokemon of the forest fear it.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Within dense forests, this Pokemon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokemon of the forest fear it.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
pokedexEntries.GO: Within dense forests, this Pokemon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokemon of the forest fear it.

name: calyrex-ice
flavorText: Calyrex is a merciful Pokemon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Calyrex is a merciful Pokemon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
pokedexEntries.GO: Calyrex is a merciful Pokemon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

name: calyrex-shadow
flavorText: Calyrex is a merciful Pokemon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Calyrex is a merciful Pokemon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
pokedexEntries.GO: Calyrex is a merciful Pokemon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.

name: venusaur-gmax
flavorText: In battle, this Pokémon swings around two thick vines that are strong enough to topple 10-story buildings.

pokedexEntries.Sword: In battle, this Pokémon swings around two thick vines that are strong enough to topple 10-story buildings.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Huge amounts of pollen burst from it with the force of a volcanic eruption. Breathing it in causes sneezing fits.
pokedexEntries.GO: In battle, this Pokémon swings around two thick vines that are strong enough to topple 10-story buildings.

name: charizard-gmax
flavorText: This colossal, flame-winged Charizard was created by the power of Gigantamax. Its flame can reach 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This colossal, flame-winged Charizard was created by the power of Gigantamax. Its flame can reach 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The flame inside its body burns hotter than 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit. When Charizard roars, that temperature climbs even higher.
pokedexEntries.GO: This colossal, flame-winged Charizard was created by the power of Gigantamax. Its flame can reach 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: blastoise-gmax
flavorText: It can adapt to any situation by using the 31 cannons on its shell, both large and small.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It can adapt to any situation by using the 31 cannons on its shell, both large and small.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Water fired from this Pokémon's central main cannon can punch a hole through a mountain.
pokedexEntries.GO: It can adapt to any situation by using the 31 cannons on its shell, both large and small.

name: butterfree-gmax
flavorText: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

pokedexEntries.Sword: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
pokedexEntries.GO: In battle, it flaps its wings at high speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.

name: pikachu-gmax
flavorText: When it smashes its opponents with its bolt-shaped tail, it delivers a surge of electricity comparable to a lightning strike.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When it smashes its opponents with its bolt-shaped tail, it delivers a surge of electricity comparable to a lightning strike.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its gigantamax energy swells within its pouch, storing enough electric power to light up an entire city.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it smashes its opponents with its bolt-shaped tail, it delivers a surge of electricity comparable to a lightning strike.

name: meowth-gmax
flavorText: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

pokedexEntries.Shield: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It loves to collect shiny things. If it's in a good mood, it might even let its Trainer have a look at its hoard of treasures.
pokedexEntries.GO: Adores circular objects. Wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

name: machamp-gmax
flavorText: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
pokedexEntries.Shield: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokemon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.
pokedexEntries.GO: Using its heavy muscles, it throws powerful punches that can send the victim clear over the horizon.

name: gengar-gmax
flavorText: Rumor has it that its gigantic mouth leads not into its body, but directly to the afterlife.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Rumor has it that its gigantic mouth leads not into its body, but directly to the afterlife.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It lays traps, hoping to steal the lives of those it catches. If you stand in front of its mouth, you'll hear your loved ones calling to you.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
pokedexEntries.GO: Rumor has it that its gigantic mouth leads not into its body, but directly to the afterlife.

name: kingler-gmax
flavorText: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
pokedexEntries.GO: The large pincer has 10000 hp of crushing power. However, its huge size makes it unwieldy to use.

name: lapras-gmax
flavorText: A Pokemon that has been over hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

pokedexEntries.Sword: A smart and kindhearted Pokemon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokemon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.
pokedexEntries.GO: A Pokemon that has been over hunted almost to extinction. It can ferry people across the water.

name: eevee-gmax
flavorText: Gigantamax energy has caused its fur to grow fluffier and more luxurious. Opponents caught in its collar are overcome with joy.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Gigantamax energy has caused its fur to grow fluffier and more luxurious. Opponents caught in its collar are overcome with joy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It has become so large and friendly that it often crushes its Trainer in affectionate hugs.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokemon evolution—I'm certain of it.
pokedexEntries.GO: Gigantamax energy has caused its fur to grow fluffier and more luxurious. Opponents caught in its collar are overcome with joy.

name: snorlax-gmax
flavorText: Seeds and pebbles that were stuck in its belly have grown into a giant tree powered by Gigantamax energy.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Seeds and pebbles that were stuck in its belly have grown into a giant tree powered by Gigantamax energy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Almost never moves. Even when battling, it only lifts its arms or shakes its body slightly to crush foes.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.
pokedexEntries.GO: Seeds and pebbles that were stuck in its belly have grown into a giant tree powered by Gigantamax energy.

name: garbodor-gmax
flavorText: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.
pokedexEntries.GO: It clenches opponents with its left arm and finishes them off with foul-smelling poison gas belched from its mouth.

name: melmetal-gmax
flavorText: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

pokedexEntries.Sword: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Centrifugal force is behind the punches of Melmetal's heavy hex-nut arms. Melmetal is said to deliver the strongest punches of all Pokemon.
pokedexEntries.GO: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.

name: rillaboom-gmax
flavorText: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

pokedexEntries.Sword: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The one with the best drumming techniques becomes the boss of the troop. It has a gentle disposition and values harmony among its group.
pokedexEntries.GO: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.

name: cinderace-gmax
flavorText: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
pokedexEntries.GO: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.

name: inteleon-gmax
flavorText: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
pokedexEntries.GO: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.

name: corviknight-gmax
flavorText: This Pokemon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
pokedexEntries.Shield: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokemon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.
pokedexEntries.GO: This Pokemon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.

name: orbeetle-gmax
flavorText: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.
pokedexEntries.GO: It's famous for its high level of intelligence, and the large size of its brain is proof that it also possesses immense psychic power.

name: drednaw-gmax
flavorText: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokemon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

pokedexEntries.Sword: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokemon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This Pokemon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
pokedexEntries.GO: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokemon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.

name: coalossal-gmax
flavorText: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
pokedexEntries.Shield: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
pokedexEntries.GO: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.

name: flapple-gmax
flavorText: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
pokedexEntries.GO: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.

name: appletun-gmax
flavorText: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokemon it preys on.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokemon it preys on.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
pokedexEntries.GO: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokemon it preys on.

name: sandaconda-gmax
flavorText: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it contracts its body, over 220 pounds of sand sprays from its nose. If it ever runs out of sand, it becomes disheartened.

name: toxtricity-amped-gmax
flavorText: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokemon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
pokedexEntries.GO: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: centiskorch-gmax
flavorText: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
pokedexEntries.Shield: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokemon also has large and very sharp fangs.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.

name: hatterene-gmax
flavorText: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

pokedexEntries.Sword: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
pokedexEntries.Shield: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokemon is also known as the Forest Witch.
pokedexEntries.GO: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.

name: grimmsnarl-gmax
flavorText: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokemon can overwhelm even Machamp.

pokedexEntries.Sword: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokemon can overwhelm even Machamp.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
pokedexEntries.GO: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokemon can overwhelm even Machamp.

name: alcremie-gmax
flavorText: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.

name: copperajah-gmax
flavorText: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

pokedexEntries.Sword: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
pokedexEntries.Shield: These Pokemon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
pokedexEntries.GO: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.

name: duraludon-gmax
flavorText: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

pokedexEntries.Sword: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokemon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.

name: urshifu-single-strike-gmax
flavorText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokemon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
pokedexEntries.GO: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

name: urshifu-rapid-strike-gmax
flavorText: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokemon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
pokedexEntries.GO: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in the one-hit ko. Its strategy is to leap in close to foes and land a devastating blow with a hardened fist.

name: toxtricity-low-key-gmax
flavorText: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
pokedexEntries.Shield: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokemon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
pokedexEntries.GO: When this Pokemon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.

name: growlithe-hisui
flavorText: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It's both clever and loyal, but if a stranger tries to invade its territory, it barks threateningly.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It looks cute, but when you approach another Trainer's Growlithe, it will bark at you and bite.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: While it's quite friendly toward humans once it's grown used to them, in the wild it must be quite fierce to defend its territory from Rockruff.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It has lived alongside humans since ages ago. Its bones have been found in excavations of ruins from the Stone Age.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: A Pokemon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: A Pokemon with a friendly nature. However, it will bark fiercely at anything invading its territory.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
pokedexEntries.GO: Very protective of its territory. It will bark and bite to repel intruders from its space.

name: arcanine-hisui
flavorText: A Pokemon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

pokedexEntries.Sun: Overflowing with beauty and majesty, this strong Pokemon appears in ancient Eastern folklore.
pokedexEntries.Moon: The fire burning inside its body serves as the energy to fuel it as it runs great distances. It appears in many legends.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: There are so many old tales about them that they're called legendary Pokemon, but there are way more of them around than you'd expect.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: A legendary Pokemon in the East. Many people are charmed by the grace and beauty of its running.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: A legendary Pokemon in the East. Many people are charmed by the grace and beauty of its running.
pokedexEntries.Sword: The sight of it running over 6,200 miles in a single day and night has captivated many people.
pokedexEntries.Shield: A Pokemon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
pokedexEntries.GO: A Pokemon that has been admired since the past for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.

name: voltorb-hisui
flavorText: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé ball, they have zapped many people.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: It is said to camouflage itself as a Poké Ball. It will self-destruct with very little stimulus.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: An enigmatic Pokemon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
pokedexEntries.GO: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a POKé ball, they have zapped many people.

name: electrode-hisui
flavorText: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

pokedexEntries.Lets Go Pikachu: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.
pokedexEntries.Lets Go Eevee: Stores electrical energy inside its body. Even the slightest shock could trigger a huge explosion.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokemon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
pokedexEntries.GO: It stores electric energy under very high pressure. It often explodes with little or no provocation.

name: typhlosion-hisui
flavorText: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
pokedexEntries.GO: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: qwilfish-hisui
flavorText: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When faced with a larger opponent, it swallows as much water as it can to match the opponent's size.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokemon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.
pokedexEntries.GO: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: sneasel-hisui
flavorText: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It uses its claws to poke holes in eggs so it can slurp out the insides. Breeders consider it a scourge and will drive it away or eradicate it.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokemon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It blends into the dark of night to ambush its prey. Sneasel will attack Sandshrew, but its hard skin can cause Sneasel's claws to snap off.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
pokedexEntries.Shield: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it sud denly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: samurott-hisui
flavorText: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokemon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
pokedexEntries.GO: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.

name: lilligant-hisui
flavorText: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokemon is popular with celebrities.

pokedexEntries.Sun: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.
pokedexEntries.Moon: As soon as it finds a male to be its partner, the beautiful flower on its head darkens, droops, and withers away.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The fragrance of its flower differs slightly depending on the soil where it grew up. Sniffing the aroma calms your heart and mind.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: It's well liked by other Pokemon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.
pokedexEntries.Sword: It's believed that even first-rate gardeners have a hard time getting the flower on a Lilligant's head to bloom.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Essential oils made from Lilligant flowers have a sublime scent, but they're also staggeringly expensive.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
pokedexEntries.GO: Even veteran Trainers face a challenge in getting its beautiful flower to bloom. This Pokemon is popular with celebrities.

name: zorua-hisui
flavorText: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: This Pokemon has a cowardly disposition, so when it's not around friends, it basically always stays transformed as something else.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Zorua is a timid Pokemon. This disposition seems to be what led to the development of Zorua's ability to take on the forms of other creatures.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Zorua sometimes transforms into a person and goes into cities to search for food. When Zorua does this, it usually takes on the form of a child.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.
pokedexEntries.GO: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.

name: zoroark-hisui
flavorText: Bonds between these Pokemon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It doesn't just transform itself—it also has the power to make hundreds of people see its illusions.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.
pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon cares deeply about others of its kind, and it will conjure terrifying illusions to keep its den and pack safe.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Seeking to ease the burden of their solitude, lonely Trainers tell Zoroark to show illusions to them.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark's own body.
pokedexEntries.GO: Bonds between these Pokemon are very strong. It protects the safety of its pack by tricking its opponents.

name: braviary-hisui
flavorText: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

pokedexEntries.Sun: With its brave disposition, it fears nothing—not even death. Ancient Alolan people respected it, referring to it as "the hero of the sky."
pokedexEntries.Moon: It's thought that people disturbed their habitats in the past, so Braviary banded together to fight back.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Known as "the hero of the skies," this Pokemon is so proud and so brave that it will never retreat, even when it's injured.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Known for its bravery and pride, this majestic Pokemon is often seen as a motif for various kinds of emblems.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Because this Pokemon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokemon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
pokedexEntries.GO: They fight for their friends without any thought about danger to themselves. One can carry a car while flying.

name: sliggoo-hisui
flavorText: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.
pokedexEntries.Moon: This Pokemon's mucous can dissolve anything. Toothless, it sprays mucous on its prey. Once they're nicely dissolved, it slurps them up.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It crawls along sluggishly. The swirly protrusion on its back is filled with its brain and other organs.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Its entire body is covered with gooey mucus that can dissolve anything. Be sure to put gloves on if you're going to touch it.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Although this Pokemon isn't very strong, its body is coated in a caustic slime that can melt through anything, so predators steer clear of it.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: A creature given to melancholy. I suspect its metallic shell developed as a result of the mucus on its skin reacting with the iron in Hisui's water.
pokedexEntries.GO: It drives away opponents by excreting a sticky liquid that can dissolve anything. Its eyes devolved, so it can't see anything.

name: goodra-hisui
flavorText: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokemon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

pokedexEntries.Sun: An amazingly friendly Pokemon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.
pokedexEntries.Moon: It gets picked on because it's meek. But then, whoever teased it gets to feel the full force of its horns and a good swatting from its thick tail.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It's very friendly toward people. If you grow close to it, Goodra will hug you with its sticky, slime-covered body. Don't get mad.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Underneath its slimy skin is a thick layer of fat, and the combination of the two makes enemies' attacks slide right off.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Sometimes it misunderstands instructions and appears dazed or bewildered. Many Trainers don't mind, finding this behavior to be adorable.
pokedexEntries.Shield: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy—it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.
pokedexEntries.GO: This very friendly Dragon-type Pokemon will hug its beloved Trainer, leaving that Trainer covered in sticky slime.

name: avalugg-hisui
flavorText: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

pokedexEntries.Sword: At high latitudes, this Pokemon can be found with clusters of Bergmite on its back as it swims among the icebergs.
pokedexEntries.Shield: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokemon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokemon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
pokedexEntries.GO: Its ice-covered body is as hard as steel. Its cumbersome frame crushes anything that stands in its way.

name: decidueye-hisui
flavorText: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

pokedexEntries.Sun: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.
pokedexEntries.Moon: Although basically cool and cautious, when it's caught by surprise, it's seized by panic.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: Decidueye can nock and fire an arrow at an enemy in a tenth of a second, so its battles are decided in the blink of an eye.
pokedexEntries.Sword: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.
pokedexEntries.Shield: In a tenth of a second, it can nock and fire an arrow quill, piercing an opponent's weak point before they notice what's happening.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokemon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
pokedexEntries.GO: It fires arrow quills from its wings with such precision, they can pierce a pebble at distances over a hundred yards.

pokedexEntries.Platinum: A legendary Pokemon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when DIALGA's heart beats.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: This Pokemon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

pokedexEntries.Pearl: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
pokedexEntries.Platinum: A legendary Pokemon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with PALKIA's every breath.
pokedexEntries.Heartgold: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.
pokedexEntries.Soulsilver: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: This Pokemon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.
pokedexEntries.GO: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

name: basculin-white-striped
flavorText: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.

pokedexEntries.Black: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.
pokedexEntries.White: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
pokedexEntries.Black 2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.White 2: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.X: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.Y: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
pokedexEntries.Omega Ruby: Red- and blue-striped Basculin are very violent and always fighting. They are also remarkably tasty.
pokedexEntries.Alpha Sapphire: Red and blue Basculin usually do not get along, but sometimes members of one school mingle with the other's school.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Sun: Savage, violent Pokemon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
pokedexEntries.Ultra Moon: When a school of Basculin appears in a lake, everything else disappears, except for Corphish and Crawdaunt. That's how violent Basculin are.
pokedexEntries.Sword: Anglers love the fight this Pokemon puts up on the hook. And there are always more to catch— many people release them into lakes illicitly.
pokedexEntries.Shield: In the past, it often appeared on the dinner table. The meat of red-striped Basculin is on the fatty side, and it's more popular with the youth.
pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
pokedexEntries.GO: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokemon are very hostile.

name: basculegion-female
flavorText: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
pokedexEntries.GO: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

name: enamorus-therian
flavorText: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokemon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

pokedexEntries.Legends Arceus: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokemon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokemon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

name: tauros-paldea-combat-breed
flavorText: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

pokedexEntries.Sword: When Tauros begins whipping itself with its tails, it's a warning that the Pokemon is about to charge with astounding speed.
pokedexEntries.Shield: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won't allow people to ride on their backs.
pokedexEntries.GO: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

pokedexEntries.Sword: This Pokemon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
pokedexEntries.Shield: When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
pokedexEntries.GO: This Pokemon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: oinkologne-female
flavorText: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

pokedexEntries.Scarlet: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It entrances female Pokemon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.
pokedexEntries.GO: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.

name: dudunsparce-three-segment
flavorText: This Pokemon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokemon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
pokedexEntries.Violet: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
pokedexEntries.GO: This Pokemon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.

name: palafin-hero
flavorText: This Pokemon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

pokedexEntries.Scarlet: This Pokemon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.
pokedexEntries.Violet: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen's, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
pokedexEntries.GO: This Pokemon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.

name: maushold-family-of-three
flavorText: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokemon, but nobody knows for sure.
